title: 英语语法
about: 从第一次对话到日常交流，一课一课慢慢来。每一课先给你一句马上能用的话，再讲清楚背后的语法。你不需要懂任何语法：每个语法词第一次出现时，都会用简单的话解释。英语的动词会变、名词分单复数、还有 a 和 the，这些都是中文里没有的，所以课程会在不同的场景里反复练习它们。所有例句都是地道的美式英语，并配有中文翻译。

lessons.title: 打招呼，介绍自己
lessons.summary: 跟别人打招呼，说出你的名字、你从哪儿来，再问问对方：你的第一段英语对话。
lessons.topic: {{I'm…}}、{{My name is…}}、{{I'm from…}}；{{am}} 和 {{are}}

goal.t: Hi, I'm Li Ming. I'm from China.
goal.tr: 你好，我叫李明。我来自中国。

dialog.t: Hi! I'm Sarah.
Hi, Sarah. My name is Li Ming.
Nice to meet you, Li Ming. Where are you from?
dialog.tr: 很高兴认识你，李明。你是哪里人？

dialog.t: I'm from China. And you?
I'm from Chicago.

blocks.p: **英语的“是”会变。** 中文的“是”只有一个，英语的“是”却跟着人变：说“我”用 {{am}}，说“你”用 {{are}}。{{I am Li Ming.}}（我是李明。）{{You are Sarah.}}（你是萨拉。）口语里通常缩短：{{I am}} 说成 {{I'm}}，{{you are}} 说成 {{you're}}。

blocks.means: 表示动作或状态的词，比如“吃”“去”“是”。英语的动词会根据“谁做”和“什么时候做”改变形式，中文的动词不变。
代替人或东西的小词，比如“我”“你”“他”。英语里是 {{I}}、{{you}}、{{he}} 等。

blocks.p: **介绍名字**有两种说法：{{I'm Li Ming.}} 或 {{My name is Li Ming.}}（我的名字是李明。）注意：英语的名字是“名在前，姓在后”，所以李明在英语里常说成 {{Ming Li}}。不过很多中国人也直接说 {{Li Ming}}，或者用一个英文名。
**说你从哪儿来**：{{I'm from}} + 国家或城市：{{I'm from China.}}（我来自中国。）{{I'm from Shanghai.}}（我是上海人。）**问对方**：{{Where are you from?}}（你是哪里人？）想把问题还给对方，就说 {{And you?}}（你呢？）

blocks.tip: 英语的“我” {{I}} 永远大写，哪怕在句子中间：{{Yes, I'm here.}}（对，我在这儿。）

mistakes.why: 中文说“我来自中国”不用“是”，但英语这个句子里一定要有 {{am}}：{{I'm from China.}}
英语的句子必须有动词，{{is}} 不能省：{{My name is Li Ming.}}

lessons.title: 说人和东西怎么样
lessons.summary: “我很累”“她很高”“今天很冷”：用英语描述人和东西。英语这里一定要有 {{be}}。
lessons.topic: {{be}} + 形容词：{{I'm tired.}}、{{She's tall.}}；{{he}}、{{she}}、{{it}}

dialog.t: Our new teacher is great.
Oh? What's he like?
She's young and very friendly.
dialog.tr: 是位女老师，很年轻，也很友好。

dialog.t: Cool. My teacher is nice too, but the class is hard.
dialog.tr: 不错。我的老师人也很好，但是课很难。

dialog.t: Yeah, English is hard!

blocks.p: **形容词前面要有 {{be}}。** 中文说“她很高”，不用“是”；英语却一定要有 {{be}}（{{am}}、{{is}}、{{are}}）：{{She is tall.}}（她很高。）{{I'm tired.}}（我很累。）没有 {{be}} 的 {{She tall.}} 是错的。另外，中文的“很”常常只是让句子听起来完整，英语不需要每次都加 {{very}}：“我很累”就是 {{I'm tired.}}

blocks.means: 描述人或东西的词，比如“高”“累”“漂亮”。英语里形容词前面要有 {{be}}：{{She is tall.}}

blocks.p: **{{he}} 和 {{she}} 不一样！** 中文的“他”和“她”读音一样，所以说话时很容易把 {{he}} 和 {{she}} 弄混。英语里 {{he}} 指男的，{{she}} 指女的，东西和动物一般用 {{it}}。说到别人时，先想一想：是男的还是女的？

ex.note: 说天气，英语用 {{it}} 当主语

blocks.tip: “我很好”最自然的说法是 {{I'm good.}} 或 {{I'm fine.}}，一般不说 {{I'm very good.}}

mistakes.why: 形容词前面一定要有 {{be}}：{{She is}}，也就是 {{She's}}。

mistakes.wrong: My mom is a doctor. He's very busy.
mistakes.right: My mom is a doctor. She's very busy.
mistakes.why: 妈妈是女的，要用 {{she}}。中文“他”“她”读音一样，英语可不一样！

lessons.title: 用 be 问“是不是”
lessons.summary: “你累吗？”“她是老师吗？”：用 {{be}} 提问，再用 {{Yes, I am.}}、{{No, she isn't.}} 回答。
lessons.topic: {{Are you…?}}、{{Is she…?}}：把 {{be}} 放到前面；简短回答 {{Yes, I am.}} / {{No, I'm not.}}

dialog.t: Are you from Korea?
No, I'm not. I'm from China.
Oh, sorry! Is this your first time in the US?
dialog.tr: 哦，不好意思！你是第一次来美国吗？

dialog.t: Yes, it is.
Are you tired?
A little. But I'm happy!

blocks.p: **问“是不是”：把 {{be}} 放到最前面。** 中文在句子后面加“吗”；英语不用“吗”，而是把 {{am}}、{{is}}、{{are}} 移到主语前面：{{You are tired.}} → {{Are you tired?}}（你累吗？）{{She is a teacher.}} → {{Is she a teacher?}}（她是老师吗？）
**回答最好不要只说 {{Yes}} 或 {{No}}。** 最自然的是“{{Yes}} / {{No}} + 主语 + {{be}}”：{{Yes, I am.}}（是的。）{{No, I'm not.}}（不是。）{{Yes, she is.}} {{No, he isn't.}} 注意：肯定的简短回答不能缩写，不能说 {{Yes, I'm.}}
**“不”是 {{not}}**，放在 {{be}} 后面：{{I'm not tired.}}（我不累。）{{he isn't}} = {{he is not}}，{{they aren't}} = {{they are not}}。

blocks.tip: 英语的是非问句，结尾语调要往上扬：{{Are you OK?}} 中文靠“吗”，英语靠语序和语调。

mistakes.why: {{she}} 用 {{is}}，提问时也一样：{{Is she…?}}
简短的肯定回答不能缩写：{{Yes, I am.}}、{{Yes, she is.}}

practice.why: {{he}} 用 {{is}}，提问时 {{Is}} 放到最前面。

lessons.title: 说职业：a 和 an
lessons.summary: “我是护士”“他们是老师”：说说自己和别人做什么工作，学会英语里最常用的小词 {{a}} 和 {{an}}。
lessons.topic: {{a}} / {{an}} + 职业：{{She's a nurse.}}、{{I'm an engineer.}}；多个人：{{They're teachers.}}

dialog.t: What do you do?
I'm an engineer. And you?
I'm a nurse.
Cool! My parents are doctors.
Really? My sister is a doctor too.

blocks.p: **英语说职业要加 {{a}}。** 中文说“我是护士”，英语要说“我是*一个*护士”：{{I'm a nurse.}} 说一个人、一样东西的时候，名词前面几乎总要有 {{a}}。

blocks.means: 表示人、东西或概念的词，比如“老师”“苹果”“城市”。
放在名词前面的小词：{{a}}、{{an}}、{{the}}。中文没有冠词，所以中国学生最容易忘记它们。

blocks.p: **{{a}} 还是 {{an}}？** 看后面那个词的**发音**：以元音（a、e、i、o、u 的音）开头的，用 {{an}}：{{an engineer}}、{{an artist}}、{{an hour}}（h 不发音）。其他的用 {{a}}：{{a teacher}}、{{a doctor}}、{{a university}}（u 读作 you）。
**两个人以上：名词加 {{-s}}，不用 {{a}}。** {{She's a teacher.}} → {{They're teachers.}}（他们是老师。）{{We're students.}}（我们是学生。）

blocks.means: 表示“两个或更多”的形式。英语名词变复数一般加 {{-s}}：{{a book}} → {{two books}}。中文的名词没有这种变化。

ex.t: My dad is a taxi driver.
I'm a student at Peking University.

blocks.tip: 问别人做什么工作，最常用的是 {{What do you do?}}（你是做什么的？）。{{What is your job?}} 听起来有点儿生硬。

mistakes.why: 一个人的职业前面要加 {{a}}：{{I'm a teacher.}}
{{engineer}} 以元音开头，用 {{an}}。
复数不用 {{a}}：{{They're doctors.}}

lessons.title: 问“谁”“什么”“哪儿”
lessons.summary: “你叫什么名字？”“她是谁？”“你多大了？”：用疑问词提问。英语的疑问词要放在句子最前面。
lessons.topic: {{What}}、{{Who}}、{{Where}}、{{How old}} + {{be}} + 主语；说年龄：{{I'm 25.}}

dialog.t: What's your name?
Liu Yang.
How old are you?
Where are you from?
I'm from Chengdu, in China.
And who's this?
This is my wife, Lin.

blocks.p: **疑问词放在最前面。** 中文的疑问词留在答案的位置（“你叫什么？”）；英语却要把疑问词移到句首，后面是 {{be}}，再后面是主语：{{What is your name?}}（你叫什么名字？）{{Where are you from?}}（你是哪里人？）

blocks.means: 用来问信息的词，比如“什么”“谁”“哪儿”。英语里是 {{what}}、{{who}}、{{where}} 等，一般放在句子开头。

table: {{Where is the bathroom?}} 洗手间在哪儿？
{{How old is your son?}} 你儿子多大了？

blocks.p: **说年龄也用 {{be}}。** 中文说“我二十五岁”，英语不说“我有二十五岁”，而是 {{I'm 25.}} 或 {{I'm 25 years old.}}，{{be}} 一定要有。

blocks.tip: 在美国，问成年人的年龄不太礼貌，除非很熟。问孩子就没问题：{{How old are you?}}

mistakes.why: 英语的疑问词要放在句首：{{What is your name?}} 中文的“你叫什么”不能照搬。
英语说年龄用 {{be}}，不用 {{have}}：{{I'm 25.}}
疑问词后面先放 {{be}}，再放主语：{{Where are you…?}}

lessons.title: 指着东西说：这个、那个
lessons.summary: “这是什么？”“那些是我的书”：用 {{this}}、{{that}}、{{these}}、{{those}} 指东西，再说说它们是什么。
lessons.topic: {{this}} / {{that}}（一个）、{{these}} / {{those}}（多个）；回答用 {{It's a…}}、{{They're…}}

dialog.t: Excuse me, what's this?
It's a persimmon.
And what are those?
Those are figs. They're very sweet.
I'll take these two.

blocks.p: **近的用 {{this}}，远的用 {{that}}。** {{this}}（这个）指离你近的东西，{{that}}（那个）指远一点儿的：{{This is my phone.}}（这是我的手机。）{{That is my car.}}（那是我的车。）
**多个东西用 {{these}} 和 {{those}}。** 英语的“这”“那”也分单复数：{{these}}（这些）、{{those}}（那些）。后面的动词也跟着变成 {{are}}，名词加 {{-s}}：{{These are my books.}}（这些是我的书。）
**回答“这是什么？”** 大家已经知道说的是哪个东西，回答时就用 {{it}}（一个）或 {{they}}（多个）：{{What's this? — It's a pen.}}（这是什么？——是一支笔。）{{What are those? — They're apples.}}（那些是什么？——是苹果。）

blocks.tip: {{th}} 的发音：舌尖轻轻放在上下牙齿之间。{{this}}、{{that}} 的 {{th}} 要振动声带，不是 z，也不是 d。

mistakes.why: 多个东西用 {{these}}，动词用 {{are}}。
{{these}} 是复数，要用 {{are}}。

lessons.title: 数东西：复数
lessons.summary: “两张票”“三个孩子”“几位？”：数东西的时候，英语的名词要变成复数。
lessons.topic: 复数加 {{-s}}：{{two tickets}}；不规则的 {{people}}、{{children}}、{{men}}、{{women}}；{{How many…?}}

dialog.t: Hi! How many tickets?
Three tickets, please. Two adults and one child.
dialog.tr: 三张票，两个大人，一个孩子。

dialog.t: That's twenty-seven dollars.
And two hot dogs, please.

blocks.p: **一个以上，名词就加 {{-s}}。** 中文说“两张票”，名词“票”不变，只靠量词。英语没有量词，但名词本身要变：{{one ticket}} → {{two tickets}}，{{one cat}} → {{three cats}}。只要是两个或更多，就一定要加 {{-s}}，哪怕前面已经有数字了。

**{{-s}} 的拼写和读音。** 一般直接加 {{-s}}；以 s、x、ch、sh 结尾的加 {{-es}}：{{box}} → {{boxes}}，{{watch}} → {{watches}}；辅音字母 + y 结尾的，把 y 变成 i 再加 {{-es}}：{{city}} → {{cities}}。读音有三种：{{books}} 的结尾读 /s/，{{dogs}} 读 /z/，{{boxes}} 读 /ɪz/。
**问数量：{{How many}} + 复数名词？** {{How many tickets?}}（几张票？）{{How many people?}}（几位？）

ex.t: My kids are five and seven.
ex.tr: 我的孩子一个五岁，一个七岁。

ex.t: The children are in the park.

blocks.tip: 数字后面的 {{-s}} 最容易忘：{{three dollars}}、{{two hours}}、{{five years}}。说的时候注意把最后的 /s/ 或 /z/ 发出来。

mistakes.why: 两个以上，名词要加 {{-s}}：{{two chairs}}。
{{child}} 的复数不规则：{{children}}。
{{person}} 的复数是 {{people}}，不再加 {{-s}}。

lessons.title: 点餐：I'd like…
lessons.summary: 在咖啡店或餐厅点东西：“我要一杯咖啡”“能给我一些水吗？”，顺便学会英语里“不能数”的东西。
lessons.topic: {{I'd like…}}、{{Can I have…?}}；{{a cup of}}、{{a glass of}}；不可数名词和 {{some}}

dialog.t: Hi! What can I get you?
I'd like a large coffee, please.
Sure. Anything else?
Can I have a glass of water, too?
Of course. For here or to go?
dialog.tr: 当然。在这儿喝还是带走？

dialog.t: To go, please.

blocks.p: **点餐最常用的两句：{{I'd like…}} 和 {{Can I have…?}}** {{I'd like}} 就是 {{I would like}}，意思是“我想要”，比 {{I want}} 礼貌得多。{{Can I have…?}}（能给我……吗？）也很自然。最后别忘了 {{please}}。

**可数和不可数。** 有些东西英语把它看成“一团”，不能直接数：{{water}}（水）、{{coffee}}（咖啡）、{{rice}}（米饭）、{{milk}}（牛奶）、{{bread}}（面包）。它们没有复数，也不能直接加 {{a}}。要数的时候，就用一个“容器”，有点儿像中文的量词：{{a cup of coffee}}（一杯咖啡）、{{a glass of water}}（一杯水）、{{a bowl of rice}}（一碗米饭）。

blocks.means: 不能直接用数字来数的名词，比如 {{water}}、{{rice}}、{{money}}。它们没有复数，前面也不能直接加 {{a}}。

table: {{a glass of milk}} 一杯牛奶
{{a piece of cake}} 一块蛋糕

blocks.p: **不说具体多少，就用 {{some}}**（一些）：{{some water}}、{{some bread}}。不过在咖啡店，大家常常直接说 {{a coffee}}、{{two coffees}}，意思是“一杯咖啡”“两杯咖啡”。

ex.t: I'd like a bowl of noodles.
Can I have the check, please?

blocks.tip: 美国的服务员常问 {{For here or to go?}}（在这儿吃还是带走？）。在餐厅吃完饭一般要给小费（{{tip}}），通常是账单的百分之十五到二十。

mistakes.why: {{water}} 不可数，不能直接加 {{a}}：说 {{some water}} 或 {{a glass of water}}。{{I'd like}} 也比 {{I want}} 礼貌。
{{coffee}} 不变，但 {{cup}} 要变复数：{{two cups of coffee}}。

lessons.title: 问价钱
lessons.summary: “这个多少钱？”“二十五块九毛九”：问价钱、听懂价钱，还有英语和中文最不一样的地方：大数字。
lessons.topic: {{How much is it?}} / {{How much are they?}}；{{hundred}}、{{thousand}}、{{million}}（一万 = {{ten thousand}}）；美元的读法

dialog.t: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?
It's sixty-nine ninety-nine.
And how much are these shoes?
They're on sale. Forty dollars.
Great, I'll take them.

blocks.p: **一样东西用 {{is}}，几样东西用 {{are}}。** {{How much is this?}}（这个多少钱？）{{How much are these?}}（这些多少钱？）回答也一样：{{It's ten dollars.}} {{They're five dollars each.}}（每个五美元。）注意：鞋、裤子、眼镜这些“成对”的东西，英语算复数：{{How much are these shoes?}}
**美元的读法。** {{$25}} 读 {{twenty-five dollars}}；{{$25.99}} 一般读 {{twenty-five ninety-nine}}，不说“点”。一美元等于一百美分（{{cents}}）。
**大数字：英语三位一组，中文四位一组。** 中文有“万”，英语没有！英语用 {{thousand}}（千）、{{million}}（百万）、{{billion}}（十亿）。所以一万是 {{ten thousand}}（十个千），十万是 {{a hundred thousand}}（一百个千），一百万是 {{a million}}。

ex.t: The car is thirty thousand dollars.

blocks.tip: 写数字时，英语每三位加一个逗号：10,000、1,000,000。年份通常两位两位地读：2026 读作 {{twenty twenty-six}}。

mistakes.why: {{these}} 是复数，要用 {{are}}。

mistakes.wrong: The car is twenty thousands dollars.
mistakes.right: The car is twenty thousand dollars.
mistakes.why: 数字后面的 {{hundred}}、{{thousand}}、{{million}} 不加 {{-s}}：{{twenty thousand}}。

lessons.title: 说是谁的
lessons.summary: “我的手机”“汤姆的车”“这是谁的？”：说东西是谁的。特别注意 {{his}} 和 {{her}}！
lessons.topic: {{my}}、{{your}}、{{his}}、{{her}}、{{our}}、{{their}}；{{Tom's}}；{{Whose…?}}；{{mine}}、{{yours}}

dialog.t: Whose bag is this?
It's not mine. I think it's Lisa's.
dialog.tr: 不是我的。我想是丽莎的。

dialog.t: Lisa, is this your bag?
Yes, it's mine! Thanks.
And this umbrella?
That's David's. His desk is over there.
dialog.tr: 那是大卫的。他的桌子在那边。

blocks.p: **“我的”“你的”：放在名词前面。** 英语的“……的”不是在每个词后面加一个字，而是换一个词：{{I}} → {{my}}，{{you}} → {{your}}。{{my phone}}（我的手机），{{your car}}（你的车）。
**{{his}} 是“他的”，{{her}} 是“她的”。** 中国学生常常把它们说反，因为中文的“他的”“她的”读音一样。记住：看主人是男是女，不看东西。丽莎的哥哥是 {{her brother}}（她的哥哥），汤姆的妈妈是 {{his mother}}（他的妈妈）。
**名字 + {{'s}}**：{{Tom's car}}（汤姆的车），{{my mom's phone}}（我妈妈的手机）。**问“谁的”**：{{Whose…?}}：{{Whose bag is this?}}（这是谁的包？）**单独用**：{{It's mine.}}（是我的。）

blocks.tip: {{it's}} 和 {{its}} 不一样：{{it's}} = {{it is}}，{{its}} 是“它的”：{{The dog wants its food.}}（狗要吃它的饭。）

mistakes.wrong: Lisa is here with his husband.
mistakes.right: Lisa is here with her husband.
mistakes.why: 丽莎是女的，用 {{her}}。主人是谁，就用谁的词。
名词表示“谁的”，要加 {{'s}}：{{my mother's car}}。

lessons.title: 说每天做什么
lessons.summary: “我每天七点起床”“我在银行工作”：用一般现在时说你的日常生活，还要把时间和地点放到句子后面。
lessons.topic: 一般现在时（{{I work}}、{{we live}}）；时间和地点放在句子后面

goal.t: I get up at seven every day.

dialog.t: I work in a bank. I start at nine.
dialog.tr: 我在银行工作，九点上班。

dialog.t: Nice. I work at home.
Really? Every day?
Yes. I get up at eight and start at nine. I love it!
dialog.tr: 对。我八点起床，九点开始工作。我很喜欢！

dialog.t: I take the subway at seven thirty.

blocks.p: **一般现在时：说习惯和事实。** 每天都做的事、一直是这样的事，用动词原形：{{I work in a bank.}}（我在银行工作。）{{We live in Boston.}}（我们住在波士顿。）主语是 {{I}}、{{you}}、{{we}}、{{they}} 的时候，动词不变。

blocks.means: 动词表示“什么时候”的形式。中文用“昨天”“正在”“了”这些词来表示时间，英语却要改变动词本身：{{I work}}（我工作），{{I worked}}（我工作过了）。
句子说的是谁或什么，通常就是做动作的人：{{I work.}} 里的 {{I}}。英语的句子几乎都要有主语。

blocks.p: **时间和地点放在后面。** 这是英语和中文很不一样的地方。中文说“我每天在家吃早饭”，时间和地点都在动词前面；英语正好相反：先说“谁做什么”，再说“在哪儿”，最后说“什么时候”：{{I eat breakfast at home every day.}}

ex.t: I get up at seven every day.
I take the subway to work.
I study English in the evening.

blocks.tip: 常用的时间说法：{{every day}}（每天）、{{in the morning}}（早上）、{{at night}}（晚上）、{{on weekends}}（周末）。一般放在句子最后，也可以放在最前面：{{Every day, I…}}

mistakes.wrong: I every day get up at seven.
mistakes.right: I get up at seven every day.
mistakes.why: 英语的时间一般放在句末：先说做什么，再说什么时候。
地点放在动词和宾语后面：{{eat breakfast at home}}。

lessons.title: 说别人做什么：加 -s
lessons.summary: “她在医院工作”“他每天跑步”：说他、她、它的时候，动词要加 {{-s}}。这是中国学生最常忘的一点。
lessons.topic: {{he}} / {{she}} / {{it}} + 动词加 {{-s}}：{{she works}}、{{he goes}}、{{it has}}

goal.t: My sister works in a hospital.

dialog.t: What does your brother do?
He teaches math. He works at a high school.
dialog.tr: 他教数学，在一所高中工作。

dialog.t: And your mom?
She has a small restaurant. She cooks every day.
dialog.tr: 她开了一家小餐馆，每天都做饭。

dialog.t: Wow, that sounds great.

blocks.p: **他、她、它：动词加 {{-s}}。** 一般现在时里，如果主语是一个人或一样东西（{{he}}、{{she}}、{{it}}、{{my mom}}、{{Tom}}），动词就要加 {{-s}}：{{I work}} → {{she works}}，{{I live}} → {{he lives}}。中文的动词从来不变，所以这个 {{-s}} 特别容易忘，说的时候要时时提醒自己。

blocks.means: 说“他”“她”“它”，或者一个人、一样东西的时候（不是“我”，也不是“你”）。这时英语一般现在时的动词要加 {{-s}}。

table: 辅音字母 + y：y 变 i 加 {{-es}}

blocks.p: **先选对 {{he}} 还是 {{she}}，再加 {{-s}}。** 别忘了前面学过的：爸爸是 {{he}}，妈妈是 {{she}}，两个都要加 {{-s}}：{{My dad works…}}、{{My mom works…}}

ex.t: My sister works in a hospital.
She goes to the gym every morning.
My dad watches TV at night.

blocks.tip: 加了 {{-s}} 的动词也有三种读音，和名词复数一样：{{works}} 的结尾读 /s/，{{lives}} 读 /z/，{{watches}} 读 /ɪz/。

mistakes.why: 主语是 {{she}}，动词要加 {{-s}}：{{works}}。
{{have}} 不规则：{{he has}}。

“她每天早上跑步。”

朋友问起你的家人。选出你的回答。

lessons.title: 说“不”：don't 和 doesn't
lessons.summary: “我不喝咖啡”“他不吃肉”：用 {{don't}} 和 {{doesn't}} 说你不做的事。
lessons.topic: {{don't}} / {{doesn't}} + 动词原形；{{be}} 的句子直接加 {{not}}

dialog.t: Do you want some wine?
No, thanks. I don't drink.
OK. And your wife? Does she eat meat?
dialog.tr: 好的。你太太呢？她吃肉吗？

dialog.t: No, she doesn't eat meat. She's a vegetarian.
No problem. We have lots of vegetables.
dialog.tr: 没问题，我们有很多蔬菜。

blocks.p: **英语的“不”要请一个帮手：{{don't}}。** 中文直接在动词前面加“不”：“我不喝”。英语不能说 {{I no drink}}，也不能说 {{I not drink}}，而是要用帮手词 {{do}} 加上 {{not}}：{{I do not drink.}}，口语里说 {{I don't drink.}}

blocks.means: 帮助主要动词的小词，比如 {{do}}、{{does}}、{{did}}。它们在否定句和问句里出场，自己没有实际的意思。

blocks.p: **他、她、它用 {{doesn't}}，后面的动词不加 {{-s}}。** {{-s}} 已经跑到 {{does}} 身上了，所以后面的动词用原形：{{She doesn't eat meat.}}（她不吃肉。）不能说 {{She doesn't eats}}。

table: {{We don't have a car.}} 我们没有车。
{{He doesn't like fish.}} 他不喜欢吃鱼。

blocks.p: **有 {{be}} 的句子不用 {{don't}}。** 句子里有 {{am}}、{{is}}、{{are}}，就直接在后面加 {{not}}：{{I'm not tired.}}（我不累。）只有普通动词才需要 {{don't}}。

ex.tr: 我的孩子们不爱吃蔬菜。

blocks.tip: {{don't}} 结尾的 t 很轻，但不能丢，不然别人会听成 {{do}}，意思正好反了！

mistakes.why: 英语的“不”要用 {{don't}} + 动词：{{I don't like}}。
{{doesn't}} 后面的动词用原形，不加 {{-s}}。
{{tired}} 是形容词，句子里用的是 {{be}}：直接说 {{I'm not}}。

practice.why: {{hungry}} 是形容词，用 {{be}} 的否定：{{I'm not}}。

lessons.title: 问别人的习惯：Do you…?
lessons.summary: “你住在哪儿？”“你喝咖啡吗？”“银行几点开门？”：用 {{do}} 和 {{does}} 提问。
lessons.topic: {{Do you…?}} / {{Does she…?}}；{{Yes, I do.}} / {{No, she doesn't.}}；{{Where do you live?}}

dialog.t: So, where do you live?
I live in Brooklyn. Do you live in the city too?
dialog.tr: 我住在布鲁克林。你也住在市里吗？

dialog.t: No, I don't. I live in New Jersey.
Do you work in Manhattan?
Yes, I do. What time do you finish work?
At six.

blocks.p: **问“你……吗？”：{{Do}} 放最前面。** 普通动词的问句，也要请帮手 {{do}} 出场：{{You live here.}} → {{Do you live here?}}（你住在这儿吗？）他、她、它用 {{does}}，后面的动词同样用原形：{{Does she work here?}}（她在这儿工作吗？）
**疑问词 + {{do}} / {{does}} + 主语 + 动词。** {{Where do you live?}}（你住在哪儿？）{{What time does the store open?}}（商店几点开门？）{{What do you do?}}（你做什么工作？）
**用帮手词来回答。** 中文回答“你喝咖啡吗？”说“喝”或“不喝”；英语用 {{do}} 回答：{{Yes, I do.}} {{No, I don't.}}

ex.t: What time does the bank open?
How do you get to work?

blocks.tip: 说得快的时候，{{do you}} 常常连读，听起来像 /dʒə/：{{D'you like it?}}

mistakes.why: {{does}} 已经带了 {{-s}}，后面的动词用原形：{{work}}。
疑问词后面要有 {{do}}：{{Where do you live?}}
{{like}} 是普通动词，用 {{do}} 提问。{{Are you…?}} 只用在 {{be}} 的句子里。

lessons.title: 说你有什么：have 和 has
lessons.summary: “我有两个孩子”“她有一辆新车”“你有时间吗？”：用 {{have}} 和 {{has}} 说你有什么。
lessons.topic: {{have}} / {{has}}；{{don't have}} / {{doesn't have}}；{{Do you have…?}}；{{have got}}（听得懂就行）

dialog.t: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
I have one brother. He has a son and a daughter.
dialog.tr: 我有一个哥哥。他有一个儿子和一个女儿。

dialog.t: So you're an aunt!
Yes! Do you have kids?
No, I don't. But I have a dog!

blocks.p: **“有”：{{have}}，他、她、它用 {{has}}。** {{I have a car.}}（我有一辆车。）{{She has a car.}}（她有一辆车。）{{has}} 就是 {{have}} 的第三人称单数形式。
**“没有”和“有没有”：也要用 {{do}}。** {{have}} 是普通动词，所以否定和提问都用 {{do}} / {{does}}：{{I don't have time.}}（我没时间。）{{He doesn't have a car.}}（他没有车。）{{Do you have a pen?}}（你有笔吗？）
**{{have got}}：听得懂就行。** 美国人有时用 {{I've got}} 代替 {{I have}}：{{I've got a meeting.}}（我有个会。）意思一样。你自己用 {{have}} 就行了。
**{{have}} 不是“那儿有”。** 中文的“有”还能说“这儿有一家银行”，英语这时不用 {{have}}，而是用 {{there is}}，下一单元会学。

ex.note: 生病也常用 {{have}}：{{have a headache}} 头疼

blocks.tip: 在商店问“有没有……”：{{Do you have this in blue?}}（这个有蓝色的吗？）{{Do you have a smaller size?}}（有小一号的吗？）

mistakes.why: “我哥哥”是“他”：{{has}}。
美式英语说“没有”用 {{don't have}}：{{I don't have a car.}}

lessons.title: 说喜欢什么
lessons.summary: “我很喜欢中国菜”“你喜欢游泳吗？”：说喜欢和不喜欢。英语里“喜欢”后面一定要有东西！
lessons.topic: {{like}} + 名词 / {{-ing}}；{{I like it.}}（宾语不能省）；{{really}} 和 {{a lot}}，不说 {{very like}}

dialog.t: Do you like American food?
Yes, I like it a lot. I really like burgers!
dialog.tr: 喜欢，很喜欢。我特别喜欢汉堡！

dialog.t: Do you like cooking?
Yes, I love cooking. I don't like washing dishes, though.
dialog.tr: 喜欢，我爱做饭。不过我不喜欢洗碗。

dialog.t: Me neither!

blocks.p: **{{like}} + 东西，或者 + {{-ing}}。** {{I like coffee.}}（我喜欢咖啡。）{{I like swimming.}}（我喜欢游泳。）说喜欢做什么，动词加 {{-ing}}（{{swim}} → {{swimming}}）；也可以说 {{like to}} + 动词：{{I like to swim.}}，意思一样。

blocks.means: 动作的对象，比如“我喜欢咖啡”里的“咖啡”，也就是 {{I like coffee.}} 里的 {{coffee}}。英语的宾语一般不能省略。

blocks.p: **宾语不能省：{{I like it.}}** 中文问“你喜欢吗？”可以答“喜欢”，不用说喜欢什么。英语一定要说出来：{{Do you like it?}}（你喜欢吗？）{{Yes, I like it.}}（喜欢。）只说 {{I like.}} 是错的。说人用 {{him}}（他）、{{her}}（她），说几样东西用 {{them}}。
**“很喜欢”：用 {{really}} 或 {{a lot}}，不用 {{very}}。** 中文的“很”可以放在“喜欢”前面，英语的 {{very}} 不行：说 {{I really like it.}} 或 {{I like it a lot.}}，不能说 {{I very like it.}} 最强烈的是 {{love}}：{{I love it!}}

table: {{I really like it.}} / {{I like it a lot.}}

blocks.tip: 中文说“我很爱吃饺子”，英语说 {{I love dumplings.}} 就够了，不用加 {{eat}}。

mistakes.why: {{very}} 不能放在动词前面：说 {{really like}} 或 {{like it a lot}}。
{{like}} 后面一定要有宾语：{{I like it.}}

lessons.title: 说东西在哪儿
lessons.summary: “我的钥匙在哪儿？”“在桌子上。”：用 {{be}} + 介词说人和东西在哪儿。
lessons.topic: {{be}} + {{in}}、{{on}}、{{under}}、{{next to}}、{{behind}}、{{in front of}}；{{Where is…?}}

dialog.t: Where are my keys?
They're on the kitchen table.
No, they aren't.

Oh, yes! They're in my bag. Thanks!

blocks.p: **说“在哪儿”也要用 {{be}}。** 中文说“我在家”，“在”就是动词；英语要用 {{be}} 再加一个表示位置的小词：{{I'm at home.}}（我在家。）{{The keys are on the table.}}（钥匙在桌子上。）

blocks.means: 放在名词前面、表示位置或关系的小词，比如 {{in}}（在……里）、{{on}}（在……上）、{{under}}（在……下面）。

blocks.p: **英语的介词在前面。** 中文说“桌子上”，“上”在名词后面；英语正好相反，介词在名词前面：{{on the table}}。所以“在桌子上”是 {{on the table}}，而不是 {{the table on}}。
**问位置：{{Where is…?}} / {{Where are…?}}** 一样东西用 {{is}}，几样东西用 {{are}}：{{Where's the bathroom?}}（洗手间在哪儿？）{{Where are my glasses?}}（我的眼镜在哪儿？）注意：名词前面通常有 {{the}} 或 {{my}}。

ex.t: The cat is under the bed.
The bank is next to the supermarket.

ex.note: {{at}}：在某个场所，比如家、公司、学校

blocks.tip: 最常用的三个：{{in}}（在里面，也用于城市和国家）、{{on}}（在表面上）、{{at}}（在某个点或场所：{{at home}}、{{at work}}、{{at the station}}）。

mistakes.right: My phone is on the table.
mistakes.why: 英语的介词放在名词前面：{{on the table}}。
说在哪儿也要有 {{be}}：{{I'm in…}}

lessons.title: 说哪儿有什么：there is / there are
lessons.summary: “附近有一家银行”“房间里有两张床”：英语说“哪儿有什么”要用 {{there is}} 和 {{there are}}，不用 {{have}}。
lessons.topic: {{There's a…}} / {{There are…}}；{{Is there…?}}；{{any}}；不说 {{Have a bank near here}}

goal.t: Is there a bank near here?

dialog.t: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
Yes, there's one on Main Street.
Is it far?
No, it's five minutes from here. There's a bank next to it.
dialog.tr: 不远，走五分钟就到。旁边还有一家银行。

dialog.t: Great, thank you!

blocks.p: **中文的“有”，英语有两种说法。** “我有一辆车”是 {{I have a car.}}；但“这儿有一家银行”说的是某个地方存在什么，英语要用 {{there is}}：{{There's a bank here.}} 不能说 {{Have a bank here.}}，这是中国学生非常常见的错误。
**一个用 {{there is}}，几个用 {{there are}}。** {{There's a cat in the room.}}（房间里有一只猫。）{{There are two beds.}}（有两张床。）口语里 {{there is}} 常常缩成 {{there's}}。地点一般放在句子最后。
**{{any}} 用在否定句和问句里**：{{Are there any restaurants near here?}}（这附近有餐厅吗？）{{There aren't any.}}（一家也没有。）回答 {{Is there…?}}，就说 {{Yes, there is.}} 或 {{No, there isn't.}}

ex.t: Is there a bank near here?
There's a café on the corner.
There are a lot of people here.
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
Are there any good restaurants near here?
There are two bedrooms in my apartment.

blocks.tip: {{there is}} 后面的东西常常是“新出现的”，所以用 {{a}}：{{There's a problem.}}（有个问题。）

mistakes.right: Is there a bank near here?
mistakes.why: 说某个地方“有”什么，用 {{there is}}，不用 {{have}}。
{{people}} 是复数：{{there are}}。

lessons.title: 说时间：at、on、in
lessons.summary: “七点见”“星期一见”“十月见”：英语说时间要用 {{at}}、{{on}}、{{in}}，写日期的顺序也和中文相反。
lessons.topic: {{at}}（钟点）、{{on}}（某一天）、{{in}}（月、年、季节、上午）；日期 {{October 24, 2026}}；{{It's three o'clock.}}

goal.t: See you on Monday at ten.

Yes. What time?
At 10:30 in the morning.

dialog.tr: 星期一是十月二十六号，对吧？

dialog.t: That's right. See you then!

blocks.p: **三个时间小词。** {{at}} 用于钟点：{{at seven}}（七点）、{{at noon}}（中午）。{{on}} 用于某一天：{{on Monday}}（星期一）、{{on May 1}}（五月一号）、{{on my birthday}}（我生日那天）。{{in}} 用于更长的时间：{{in October}}（十月）、{{in 2026}}、{{in the morning}}（上午）、{{in the summer}}（夏天）。

table: 月、年、季节、一天里的时段

blocks.p: **日期：英语从小到大，中文从大到小。** 中文写“二〇二六年十月二十四日”；美式英语写 {{October 24, 2026}}，读作 {{October twenty-fourth, twenty twenty-six}}。日子要读成“第几”：{{first}}、{{second}}、{{third}}、{{fourth}}……
**说钟点要有 {{It's}}。** 中文说“现在三点”，英语要有主语 {{it}}：{{What time is it?}}（几点了？）{{It's three o'clock.}}（三点。）{{It's 3:30.}} 读作 {{three thirty}}。

ex.t: See you on Monday at ten.
We go to the beach in the summer.
I work out in the morning.

blocks.tip: 有些时间说法不用介词：{{today}}、{{tomorrow}}、{{every day}}、{{this week}}、{{next Monday}}。不能说 {{on next Monday}}。

mistakes.why: 某一天用 {{on}}：{{on Monday}}。
英语说钟点要有主语和 {{be}}：{{It's…}}

mistakes.tr: 二〇二六年十月二十四日
mistakes.why: 美式英语的日期顺序是：月、日、年。

lessons.title: 说会做什么、能做什么：can
lessons.summary: “我会游泳”“我明天不能来”“我可以坐这儿吗？”：中文的“会”“能”“可以”，英语常常都用一个 {{can}}。
lessons.topic: {{can}} / {{can't}} + 动词原形（不加 {{-s}}，不加 {{to}}）；{{Can you…?}}（请求）；{{Can I…?}}（许可）

goal.t: I can speak a little English.

dialog.t: Can you drive?
Yes, I can. Why?
Can you drive me to the airport tomorrow?
dialog.tr: 明天你能开车送我去机场吗？

dialog.t: Sorry, I can't. I have a meeting.
dialog.tr: 不好意思，去不了，我有个会。

dialog.t: No problem. Can I use your phone? My battery is dead.
dialog.tr: 没关系。我能用一下你的手机吗？我的没电了。

dialog.t: Sure, here you go.

blocks.p: **{{can}}：会、能、可以。** 中文分得很细：学会的本领是“会”，有能力、有条件是“能”，被允许是“可以”。英语这三种意思常常都用 {{can}}：{{I can swim.}}（我会游泳。）{{I can't come tomorrow.}}（我明天不能来。）{{Can I sit here?}}（我可以坐这儿吗？）

blocks.means: 放在动词前面、表示“能”“应该”“必须”等意思的词，比如 {{can}}、{{should}}、{{must}}。后面的动词总是用原形。

blocks.p: **{{can}} 永远不变，后面的动词也不变。** {{can}} 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 {{to}}，也不加 {{-s}}；说他、她、它的时候，{{can}} 本身也不加 {{-s}}：{{She can speak French.}}（她会说法语。）否定是 {{can't}}（也写作 {{cannot}}）；提问就把 {{can}} 放到前面：{{Can you help me?}}，不需要 {{do}}。

ex.t: I can speak a little English.

blocks.tip: {{can}} 和 {{can't}} 听起来很像：{{can}} 在句子里读得很轻，像 /kən/；{{can't}} 读得又重又长，像 /kænt/。听重音就能分辨。

mistakes.why: {{can}} 不加 {{-s}}，后面的动词也不加。
{{can}} 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 {{to}}。

lessons.title: 说正在做什么
lessons.summary: “我正在做饭”“你在干什么？”：用 {{am}} / {{is}} / {{are}} + {{-ing}} 说此时此刻正在发生的事。
lessons.topic: 现在进行时：{{be}} + 动词 {{-ing}}；和一般现在时的区别

dialog.t: Hi! What are you doing?
I'm cooking dinner. What about you?
I'm watching a movie with my sister.
Is it good?
Yes! Oh, wait, my mom is calling. Talk later!
dialog.tr: 好看！哦，等一下，我妈打电话来了。回头聊！

blocks.p: **正在做：{{be}} + 动词 {{-ing}}。** 中文用“在”“正在”“呢”表示动作正在进行；英语用 {{am}}、{{is}}、{{are}} 加上动词的 {{-ing}} 形式：{{I'm cooking.}}（我在做饭。）{{She's sleeping.}}（她在睡觉。）两部分一个都不能少。

blocks.means: 表示动作正在进行的形式：{{be}} + 动词 {{-ing}}，比如 {{I'm reading.}}（我在看书。）

blocks.p: **{{-ing}} 的拼写。** 一般直接加：{{read}} → {{reading}}；不发音的 e 去掉：{{make}} → {{making}}；短词以“一个元音 + 一个辅音”结尾的，辅音双写：{{swim}} → {{swimming}}，{{run}} → {{running}}。
**现在 vs. 每天。** 中文的“我做饭”可以是习惯，也可以是现在；英语分得很清楚：每天都这样，用一般现在时：{{I cook every day.}}（我每天做饭。）此时此刻，用进行时：{{I'm cooking now.}}（我现在在做饭。）

table: {{He works in a bank.}} 他在银行工作。
{{He's working now.}} 他现在在上班。
{{I don't watch TV.}} 我不看电视。
{{I'm not watching TV.}} 我没在看电视。
{{Do you study English?}} 你学英语吗？

blocks.tip: 有些动词表示状态，不表示动作，一般不用 {{-ing}}：{{know}}、{{like}}、{{want}}、{{need}}。所以说 {{I know.}}，不说 {{I'm knowing.}}

mistakes.why: 进行时要有 {{be}}：{{I'm cooking}}。
{{be}} 后面的动词要加 {{-ing}}：{{working}}。
{{want}} 表示状态，不用进行时：{{I want…}}

lessons.title: 说计划：be going to
lessons.summary: “我打算学开车”“这个周末我要去看爸妈”：用 {{be going to}} 说打算，用 {{-ing}} 说已经安排好的事。
lessons.topic: {{be going to}} + 动词原形；用现在进行时说安排好的事；将来的时间放在句末

goal.t: I'm going to visit my parents this weekend.
goal.tr: 这个周末我要去看我爸妈。

dialog.t: What are you going to do this weekend?
dialog.tr: 你这个周末打算做什么？

dialog.t: I'm going to visit my parents. They live in New Jersey.

dialog.t: Nice. Are you going to drive?
No, I'm taking the train on Saturday morning.

dialog.t: Sounds good. I'm going to stay home and relax.
dialog.tr: 听起来不错。我打算待在家里放松一下。

blocks.p: **打算：{{be going to}} + 动词原形。** 中文说“我打算……”“我要……”；英语用 {{am}} / {{is}} / {{are}} + {{going to}} + 动词：{{I'm going to learn to drive.}}（我打算学开车。）{{She's going to move.}}（她要搬家了。）
**已经安排好的事：用现在进行时。** 时间地点都定了（买了票、约好了人），美国人常用进行时加一个将来的时间：{{I'm meeting Tom at six.}}（我六点和汤姆见面。）{{We're flying to Chicago on Friday.}}（我们星期五飞芝加哥。）
**将来的时间也放在句末**：{{tomorrow}}、{{next week}}、{{this weekend}}、{{in two days}}（两天以后）。中文的“明天我去”，英语说 {{I'm going tomorrow.}}

ex.t: I'm going to visit my parents this weekend.
ex.tr: 这个周末我要去看我爸妈。

ex.t: What are you going to do tomorrow?
She's going to have a baby.
We're not going to buy a car.

ex.note: 看到乌云，知道要下雨：也用 {{going to}}

blocks.tip: 口语里 {{going to}} 常常说成 {{gonna}}：{{I'm gonna call you.}} 听得懂就好，正式写作别用。

mistakes.wrong: I'm going to next week visit them.
mistakes.right: I'm going to visit them next week.
mistakes.why: 时间放在句末：{{next week}}。

lessons.summary: “我来帮你”“我觉得明天会下雨”“我不会忘的”：用 {{will}} 说当场的决定、主动帮忙、承诺和预测。
lessons.topic: {{will}} / {{won't}} + 动词原形；{{I'll…}}；{{will}} 和 {{going to}} 的区别

dialog.t: This box is so heavy!
I'll help you.
Thanks! Can you hold the door too?

I'm moving tomorrow. I think it will take all day.

dialog.t: I'll come and help. I won't be late!
dialog.tr: 我来帮忙。我不会迟到的！

blocks.p: **{{will}} + 动词原形。** {{will}} 也是情态动词，后面跟动词原形，对谁都不变：{{I will}}、{{she will}}，口语里缩成 {{I'll}}、{{she'll}}。否定是 {{won't}}（= {{will not}}）。
**{{will}} 的四种用法。** 当场决定：{{The phone's ringing. — I'll get it.}}（电话响了。——我来接。）主动帮忙：{{I'll carry that.}}（我来拿。）承诺：{{I won't forget.}}（我不会忘的。）预测：{{I think it will rain tomorrow.}}（我觉得明天会下雨。）
**{{will}} 还是 {{going to}}？** 事先想好的计划，用 {{going to}}：{{I'm going to paint my room this weekend.}}（这个周末我要刷墙，早就计划好了。）说话这一刻才决定的，用 {{will}}：{{Oh, you need paint? I'll get some.}}（哦，你需要油漆？我去买。）

ex.t: I think it will rain tomorrow.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
ex.tr: 别担心，我不会告诉任何人。

blocks.tip: {{I'll}} 读作 /aɪl/，说快了很多人听不出来，注意结尾那个轻轻的 /l/。

mistakes.why: {{will}} 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 {{to}}。
{{will}} 对谁都不变，不加 {{-s}}。

lessons.title: 提建议和客气地请求
lessons.summary: “我们去喝杯咖啡吧！”“你能帮我一下吗？”“要来点儿茶吗？”：提建议、请人帮忙、邀请别人，都说得客客气气。
lessons.topic: {{Let's…}}、{{How about…?}}、{{Why don't we…?}}；{{Could you…?}}；{{Would you like…?}}

dialog.t: I'm bored. Let's do something!
dialog.tr: 好无聊。我们找点儿事做吧！

dialog.t: How about a movie?
Hmm, why don't we go for a walk? It's a nice day.
dialog.tr: 嗯……要不我们去散散步？今天天气很好。

dialog.t: Good idea. Could you wait five minutes? I need to change.
dialog.tr: 好主意。你能等我五分钟吗？我得换件衣服。

dialog.t: Sure. Would you like a coffee first?
dialog.tr: 没问题。要先来杯咖啡吗？

dialog.t: No, thanks. Let's go!

blocks.p: **提建议。** {{Let's}} + 动词原形，就是“我们……吧”：{{Let's go!}}（走吧！）{{How about}} + 名词或 {{-ing}}，是“……怎么样？”：{{How about pizza?}} {{How about going tomorrow?}} {{Why don't we}} + 动词，是“我们何不……？”：{{Why don't we take a taxi?}}
**客气地请别人做事：{{Could you…?}}** {{Can you…?}} 朋友之间可以用，{{Could you…?}} 更礼貌，对陌生人、同事、服务员都合适：{{Could you help me?}}（您能帮我一下吗？）{{Could you say that again, please?}}（您能再说一遍吗？）
**邀请和提供：{{Would you like…?}}** 比 {{Do you want…?}} 礼貌：{{Would you like some tea?}}（要来点儿茶吗？）{{Would you like to come?}}（你想一起来吗？）回答：{{Yes, please.}} / {{No, thank you.}}

ex.t: Could you help me with my bag?
Could you speak more slowly, please?

blocks.tip: 听不懂的时候，这句最有用：{{Sorry, could you say that again?}}（不好意思，您能再说一遍吗？）

mistakes.why: {{Let's}} 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 {{to}}。

mistakes.wrong: How about go to the park?
mistakes.right: How about going to the park?
mistakes.why: {{How about}} 后面的动词要加 {{-ing}}：{{going}}。
请别人帮忙，英语习惯用问句，最礼貌的是 {{Could you…?}}

lessons.title: 说你在哪儿：was / were
lessons.summary: “我昨天在家”“周末你在哪儿？”：用 {{was}} 和 {{were}} 说过去在哪儿、怎么样。
lessons.topic: {{be}} 的过去式：{{was}}（{{I}}、{{he}}、{{she}}、{{it}}）/ {{were}}（{{you}}、{{we}}、{{they}}）；{{yesterday}}、{{last…}}、{{…ago}}

dialog.t: Where were you yesterday? You weren't at work.
dialog.tr: 你昨天去哪儿了？你没来上班。

dialog.t: I was sick. I was at home all day.
Oh no! Are you OK now?
Yes, I'm fine now. Was the meeting long?
dialog.tr: 好了，现在没事了。会开得久吗？

dialog.t: Yes, and it was really boring!

blocks.p: **说过去，动词要变。** 中文说“我昨天在家”，“在”不用变，有“昨天”就知道是过去；英语不行，{{be}} 本身要变成过去式：{{I'm at home.}}（我在家。）→ {{I was at home.}}（我那时在家。）
**否定和提问**：{{wasn't}}（= {{was not}}）、{{weren't}}（= {{were not}}）；提问就把 {{was}} / {{were}} 放到前面：{{Were you at home?}}（你在家吗？）{{Was it good?}}（好吗？）
**过去的时间词**，一般放在句末：{{yesterday}}（昨天）、{{last night}}（昨晚）、{{last week}}（上周）、{{two days ago}}（两天前）。注意：“上周”是 {{last week}}，前面不加 {{the}}；“……以前”是时间 + {{ago}}。

ex.t: We were in Paris two years ago.

blocks.tip: {{was}} 和 {{were}} 在句子里通常读得很轻：/wəz/、/wər/。但在简短回答里要读清楚：{{Yes, I was.}}

mistakes.why: 说过去，{{be}} 也要变成过去式：{{was}}。
{{they}} 用 {{were}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
“三天前”是……
“你周末在哪儿？”

lessons.title: 说你做了什么：-ed
lessons.summary: “我昨天打扫了公寓”“我们看了一部电影”：说过去发生的事，英语的动词要变成过去式，最常见的是加 {{-ed}}。
lessons.topic: 规则动词的过去式：加 {{-ed}}（三种读音 /t/、/d/、/ɪd/）；每个动词都要变

dialog.t: What did you do last weekend?
I stayed home. I cleaned the apartment and cooked dinner for my friends.
dialog.tr: 我待在家里，打扫了公寓，还给朋友做了晚饭。

dialog.t: Nice! What did you cook?
I cooked dumplings. We talked and laughed all night.
dialog.tr: 我包了饺子。我们聊了一晚上，也笑了一晚上。

dialog.t: That sounds like fun.

blocks.p: **每个动词都要变。** 中文用“了”或者时间词表示过去，动词本身不变：“我昨天打扫房间”。英语不一样：只要是过去的事，动词就要换成过去式，哪怕句子里已经有了 {{yesterday}}：{{I clean}} → {{I cleaned}}。这是中国学生最容易漏掉的地方。

blocks.means: 动词表示过去发生的形式，比如 {{cleaned}}、{{watched}}、{{went}}。过去式对所有人都一样，不加 {{-s}}。

blocks.p: **规则动词：加 {{-ed}}。** {{work}} → {{worked}}，{{watch}} → {{watched}}；以 e 结尾的只加 {{-d}}：{{live}} → {{lived}}；辅音字母 + y：{{study}} → {{studied}}；短词以“一个元音 + 一个辅音”结尾的，辅音双写：{{stop}} → {{stopped}}。对谁都一样：{{I worked}}、{{she worked}}。

table: 在 p、k、s、sh、ch、f 这些清辅音后面
在 t 和 d 后面

blocks.p: **别多加一个音节。** {{walked}} 只有一个音节，读 /wɔkt/，不是 walk-ed；只有在 t 和 d 后面，{{-ed}} 才单独读成一个音节：{{wanted}}。

ex.t: We watched a movie last night.
ex.tr: 我们昨晚看了一部电影。

ex.t: They lived in Texas for two years.
ex.tr: 他们在得克萨斯州住过两年。

ex.t: I called my mom this morning.
ex.tr: 我今天早上给妈妈打了电话。

blocks.tip: 听英语的时候，{{-ed}} 很轻，常常和后面的词连在一起：{{I walked to work}}。可以靠时间词（{{yesterday}}、{{last week}}）帮你判断是不是过去。

mistakes.why: 已经有了 {{yesterday}}，动词也要变成过去式：{{cleaned}}。
过去式对谁都一样，不再加 {{-s}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.tr: 我昨晚给妈妈打了电话。

practice.q: {{wanted}} 的 {{-ed}} 怎么读？
“她上周搬家了。”
practice.why: 以 e 结尾加 {{-d}}：{{moved}}，对谁都一样。

lessons.title: 讲发生了什么：不规则动词
lessons.summary: “我去了西安”“我们吃了火锅”“我看到了一只熊猫”：最常用的动词偏偏不规则，要一个一个记。
lessons.topic: 常用的不规则过去式：{{went}}、{{saw}}、{{ate}}、{{had}}、{{got}}、{{came}}、{{bought}}、{{took}}、{{made}}、{{said}}

goal.t: I went to Xi'an last summer.

dialog.t: How was your trip?
Amazing! I went to Xi'an with my parents.
dialog.tr: 太棒了！我和爸妈去了西安。

dialog.t: What did you see?
We saw the Terracotta Warriors. We ate a lot of noodles too.
dialog.tr: 我们看了兵马俑，还吃了很多面。

dialog.t: Did you buy anything?
Yes, I bought you a present!
dialog.tr: 买了，我给你买了个礼物！

blocks.p: **最常用的动词，过去式偏偏不规则。** 大部分动词加 {{-ed}} 就行，可最常用的那些却是不规则的，只能一个一个记住。好消息是：过去式对所有人都一样，{{I went}}、{{she went}}、{{they went}}。
**{{have}} 不只是“有”。** {{had}} 也常常表示“吃了”“度过了”：{{We had dinner at seven.}}（我们七点吃的晚饭。）{{I had a great time.}}（我玩得很开心。）

ex.t: I went to Xi'an last summer.
We ate hot pot for dinner.
I saw a panda at the zoo!

blocks.tip: 每天记两三个就好，记住以后马上用它们说一句关于你自己的话：{{I got up at seven. I took the bus.}}

mistakes.why: {{go}} 不规则：过去式是 {{went}}。

mistakes.wrong: Last week I buy a car.
mistakes.right: Last week I bought a car.
mistakes.why: 过去的事，动词要变：{{buy}} → {{bought}}。

lessons.title: 问过去的事：did
lessons.summary: “你昨天去哪儿了？”“我没去”：问过去的事、说没做的事，都要用 {{did}}，后面的动词变回原形。
lessons.topic: {{Did you…?}}；{{didn't}} + 动词原形；{{What did you do?}}、{{Where did you go?}}

goal.t: Where did you go on vacation?

dialog.t: Did you watch the game last night?
No, I didn't. I went to bed early.
Really? What did you do yesterday?
I helped my friend move. I didn't sit down all day!
dialog.tr: 我帮朋友搬家，一整天都没坐下来过！

dialog.t: No wonder you were tired.

blocks.p: **问过去：{{Did}} + 主语 + 动词原形？** 现在时的问句用 {{do}}，过去时就用 {{did}}，后面的动词变回原形：{{You went.}} → {{Did you go?}}（你去了吗？）{{Did she call?}}（她打电话了吗？）对谁都用 {{did}}。
**没做：{{didn't}} + 动词原形。** 中文说“我没去”；英语说 {{I didn't go.}} 过去的意思已经在 {{didn't}} 里了，所以后面不能再用过去式：不能说 {{I didn't went.}}
**有 {{was}} / {{were}} 的句子不用 {{did}}。** 直接提问，或者加 {{not}}：{{Were you tired?}}，不能说 {{Did you tired?}}

ex.t: Where did you go on vacation?

blocks.tip: {{Did you…?}} 说快了会连读，听起来像 /dɪdʒə/：{{Did you eat?}}

mistakes.why: {{didn't}} 后面用动词原形：{{go}}。
{{did}} 后面用原形：{{see}}。
过去的问句要用 {{did}}：{{Where did you go?}}

practice.q: 选出正确的词。

lessons.title: 说以前常做的事：used to
lessons.summary: “我以前住在北京”“我以前不喝咖啡”：用 {{used to}} 说过去的习惯，和现在已经不同的事。
lessons.topic: {{used to}} + 动词原形；{{didn't use to}}；{{Did you use to…?}}

goal.t: I used to live in Beijing.

dialog.t: Is that you? Your hair is so long!
Yes! I used to have long hair in college.
dialog.tr: 对！我上大学的时候是长头发。

dialog.t: And who's this?
That's my best friend. We used to do everything together.
dialog.tr: 那是我最好的朋友。我们以前做什么都在一起。

dialog.t: Do you still see her?
Not often. She lives in London now.
dialog.tr: 不常见了。她现在住在伦敦。

blocks.p: **{{used to}}：以前常常这样，现在不了。** 中文说“我以前……”；英语用 {{used to}} + 动词原形，说过去的习惯或状态，同时暗示现在已经不是这样了：{{I used to smoke.}}（我以前抽烟，现在不抽了。）{{She used to live here.}}（她以前住在这儿。）
**{{used to}} 对谁都一样**，后面是动词原形：{{He used to play basketball.}} 否定和问句用 {{did}}，这时写成 {{use to}}（没有 d）：{{I didn't use to like coffee.}}（我以前不喜欢咖啡。）{{Did you use to live here?}}（你以前住这儿吗？）

table: {{Did you use to play the piano?}}
{{I used to live in Beijing, but now I live in Boston.}}
我以前住在北京，现在住在波士顿。

blocks.p: **{{used to}} 还是一般过去时？** 只发生过一次的事，用一般过去时：{{I went to Paris in 2019.}} 很多年里常常这样的事，用 {{used to}}：{{I used to go to Paris every summer.}}（我以前每年夏天都去巴黎。）

ex.t: I used to live in Beijing.
We used to play here when we were kids.
ex.tr: 我们小时候常在这儿玩。

ex.t: I didn't use to like vegetables.
Did you use to have a dog?
There used to be a cinema here.
ex.tr: 这里以前有一家电影院。

blocks.tip: {{used to}} 读作 /ˈjuːstə/，d 和 t 连在一起，几乎听不出 d。

mistakes.wrong: I use to live in Beijing.
mistakes.right: I used to live in Beijing.
mistakes.why: 肯定句里是 {{used to}}，有 d。
{{used to}} 后面用动词原形：{{live}}。
有了 {{didn't}}，后面写 {{use to}}，没有 d。

lessons.title: 比较：-er than / more… than
lessons.summary: “今天比昨天冷”“这套比那套贵”“我没有我哥哥高”：比较两个人或两样东西。
lessons.topic: 短形容词 + {{-er than}}；长形容词 {{more… than}}；{{better}}、{{worse}}；{{as… as}}、{{not as… as}}

goal.t: My brother is taller than me.

dialog.t: This apartment is bigger than the other one.
Yes, but it's more expensive.
It's newer, and it's closer to the subway.
Hmm. Is it quieter?
Not really. The other one is quieter, but it's not as nice.
dialog.tr: 不太。另一套更安静，但没这套好。

blocks.p: **英语的形容词自己会变。** 中文说“A 比 B 高”，“高”不变；英语要把形容词变成比较级：{{tall}} → {{taller}}，再用 {{than}}（比）连接：{{He is taller than me.}}（他比我高。）注意语序：先说 A，再说 {{be}} 和比较级，最后才是 {{than}} B。

blocks.means: 形容词表示“更……”的形式，比如 {{taller}}（更高）、{{more expensive}}（更贵）。

blocks.p: **短词加 {{-er}}，长词用 {{more}}。** 一两个音节的词加 {{-er}}：{{cheap}} → {{cheaper}}，{{big}} → {{bigger}}（双写），{{easy}} → {{easier}}（y 变 i）。三个音节以上的，前面加 {{more}}：{{more expensive}}、{{more beautiful}}。两种方法不能一起用：不能说 {{more taller}}。

table: {{This one is cheaper.}} 这个更便宜。
{{Our new house is bigger.}} 我们的新房子更大。
{{The test was easier than I thought.}} 考试比我想的容易。
{{The traffic is worse today.}} 今天堵得更厉害。

blocks.p: **一样和没那么：{{as… as}}。** {{as}} + 形容词原形 + {{as}}：{{She's as tall as her mom.}}（她和她妈妈一样高。）否定的 {{not as… as}}，就是中文的“没有……那么……”：{{I'm not as busy as you.}}（我没有你那么忙。）

ex.t: My brother is taller than me.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
Your English is better than mine.
The subway is faster than the bus.
I'm not as busy as you.

blocks.tip: “比我高”，口语里说 {{taller than me}}，比较正式的写法是 {{taller than I am}}。两种都对。

mistakes.wrong: He is more taller than me.
mistakes.why: 短形容词只加 {{-er}}，不再加 {{more}}。
英语的语序：A + {{be}} + 比较级 + {{than}} + B。
{{good}} 的比较级不规则：{{better}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: The subway is ___ than the bus.

practice.q: “这本书比那本有意思。”
options: {{This book is more interesting than that one.}}
{{This book is interestinger than that one.}}
{{This book is more interestinger than that one.}}

practice.q: “我没有我姐姐那么高。”
options: {{I'm not as tall as my sister.}}

practice.q: 和朋友选晚饭吃什么。选出你的回答。

options: Pizza. It's more cheap than sushi.

lines.t: But the sushi place is closer.

options: OK, and it's better than the pizza place too.
OK, and it's more good than the pizza place too.

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：比较你住的城市和另一个城市，或者比较你和一个家人。

answers.t: New York is bigger than my hometown, but it's more expensive.
answers.tr: 纽约比我的家乡大，但是更贵。

answers.t: My sister is younger than me, but she's taller. I'm not as funny as her.
answers.tr: 我妹妹比我小，但比我高。我没有她那么有趣。

lessons.title: 说最……的
lessons.summary: “他是我们班最高的”“这是城里最好吃的披萨”：用最高级说“最……”。
lessons.topic: {{the}} + {{-est}}；{{the most}} + 长形容词；{{the best}}、{{the worst}}；{{in}} / {{of}}；{{one of the…}}

goal.t: This is the best pizza in town.
goal.tr: 这是城里最好吃的披萨。

dialog.t: This is the oldest building in the city.
dialog.tr: 这是城里最古老的建筑。

dialog.t: Wow. And what's that tall one?
That's the tallest building in the state.
Cool! Where's the best place for dinner?
Luigi's. It's one of the most popular restaurants here.
dialog.tr: 路易吉餐厅，是这儿最受欢迎的餐厅之一。

blocks.p: **“最……”：{{the}} + {{-est}}，或者 {{the most}}。** 中文在形容词前面加“最”；英语和比较级一样分长短：短词加 {{-est}}：{{tall}} → {{the tallest}}；长词用 {{the most}}：{{the most expensive}}。前面通常要有 {{the}}。

blocks.means: 形容词表示“最……”的形式，比如 {{the tallest}}（最高的）、{{the most beautiful}}（最漂亮的）。

blocks.p: **“在……里最……”：地方用 {{in}}，一组人或东西用 {{of}}。** {{the tallest in the class}}（班里最高的），{{the best of the three}}（三个里最好的）。注意顺序：中文“班里最高的”，“班里”在前；英语的 {{in the class}} 放在后面。
**“最……之一”：{{one of the}} + 最高级 + 复数名词。** {{It's one of the best restaurants in New York.}}（这是纽约最好的餐厅之一。）名词一定要用复数。

ex.t: This is the best pizza in town.
ex.tr: 这是城里最好吃的披萨。

ex.t: He's the tallest in our class.
It's the most expensive hotel in the city.
Today is the hottest day of the year.
ex.tr: 今天是一年中最热的一天。

ex.t: She's one of my best friends.
ex.tr: 她是我最好的朋友之一。

ex.t: That was the worst movie ever!

blocks.tip: {{favorite}}（最喜欢的）本身就有“最”的意思，不用再加 {{most}}：{{my favorite food}}（我最喜欢的食物）。

mistakes.right: He is the tallest in the class.
mistakes.why: 最高级前面要加 {{the}}。

mistakes.wrong: It's one of the best restaurant.
mistakes.right: It's one of the best restaurants.
mistakes.why: {{one of the}} 后面的名词要用复数。
短词只加 {{-est}}，不再加 {{most}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: This is the ___ day of the year.
practice.tr: 这是一年中最热的一天。
practice.why: 最高级：{{the hottest}}（t 要双写）。

practice.q: “她是我们公司最聪明的人。”
options: {{She's the smartest person in our company.}}
{{She's the smartest person of our company.}}

practice.q: “这是我最喜欢的歌之一。”
options: {{It's one of my most favorite songs.}}
practice.why: {{one of}} + 复数名词；{{favorite}} 不加 {{most}}。

practice.q: 朋友问起你的家乡。选出你的回答。

lines.t: What's the best thing about your hometown?

options: The food! It's the best in China.
The food! It's the goodest in China.
Hot pot. It's the most popular dish there.
Hot pot. It's the popularest dish there.

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：介绍你的城市：最好的餐厅、最高的楼、最美的地方。

answers.t: The best restaurant in my city is a small noodle shop. The tallest building is the TV tower.
answers.tr: 我们城市最好的餐厅是一家小面馆，最高的楼是电视塔。

answers.t: The most beautiful place in my hometown is the lake. It's one of the most popular places in the area.
answers.tr: 我家乡最美的地方是那个湖，是当地最受欢迎的地方之一。

lessons.title: 说做得怎么样：副词
lessons.summary: “他英语说得很好”“请开慢点儿”：中文用“得”，英语用副词，而且副词常常放在最后。
lessons.topic: 副词：{{slowly}}、{{carefully}}、{{well}}、{{fast}}、{{hard}}；放在动词和宾语后面；{{good}} 和 {{well}}

dialog.t: You did very well on the test!
Thank you! I studied really hard.
And you speak very clearly now.
dialog.tr: 而且你现在说得很清楚。

dialog.t: But I still speak slowly.
That's OK. Slow and clear is perfect.
dialog.tr: 没关系。又慢又清楚，就很好了。

blocks.p: **“得”的英语：副词放在后面。** 中文说“他英语说得很好”，用“得”把“怎么样”接在动词后面。英语用副词，放在动词（和宾语）的后面：{{He speaks English well.}}（他英语说得好。）{{She drives carefully.}}（她开车很小心。）副词不能夹在动词和宾语中间：不能说 {{He speaks well English.}}

blocks.means: 说明动作“怎么做”的词，比如 {{slowly}}（慢慢地）、{{well}}（好）。很多副词是形容词加 {{-ly}}。

blocks.p: **形容词 + {{-ly}} = 副词。** {{slow}} → {{slowly}}，{{careful}} → {{carefully}}，{{quiet}} → {{quietly}}，{{easy}} → {{easily}}。几个特别的：{{good}} → {{well}}；{{fast}}、{{hard}}、{{late}}、{{early}} 不变。

table: {{She's a good singer.}} 她是个好歌手。
{{He's a careful driver.}} 他是个小心的司机。
{{He drives carefully.}} 他开车很小心。
{{It's a fast car.}} 这是辆快车。
{{I'm a hard worker.}} 我是个勤快的人。
{{I work hard.}} 我工作很努力。

blocks.p: **{{good}} 还是 {{well}}？** 说人或东西用 {{good}}：{{Your English is good.}}（你的英语很好。）说动作用 {{well}}：{{You speak English well.}}（你英语说得很好。）

ex.t: I didn't sleep well last night.

ex.tr: 孩子们在安安静静地玩。

blocks.tip: {{hard}} 和 {{hardly}} 意思完全不一样！{{I work hard.}} 是“我很努力”，{{I hardly work.}} 是“我几乎不工作”。

mistakes.why: 副词放在宾语后面：{{speaks English well}}。
说动作用副词 {{well}}，不用 {{good}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
“他英语说得很好。”
practice.why: 副词放在动词和宾语后面。

practice.q: {{careful}} 的副词是……
面试的时候。选出你的回答。

options: Yes, I speak it fluently. It's my first language.
Yes, I speak fluently it. It's my first language.
lines.why: 副词放在宾语 {{it}} 后面。

options: It's good. I can work well in English.
It's well. I can work good in English.
lines.why: 说英语本身（东西）用 {{good}}，说动作用 {{well}}。

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：说两件你做得好的事和一件做得不太好的事。

answers.t: I cook well and I swim fast. I don't sing very well.
answers.tr: 我做饭做得好，游泳游得快。我唱歌唱得不太好。

answers.t: I work hard and I learn quickly. I speak English slowly.
answers.tr: 我工作很努力，学东西很快。我英语说得很慢。

lessons.title: 说多少：much、many、a lot of
lessons.summary: “有多少人来？”“只有一点儿时间”“你们有什么问题吗？”：说数量多少，先要分清能数的和不能数的。
lessons.topic: {{many}} + 可数复数、{{much}} + 不可数；{{a lot of}}；{{a few}} / {{a little}}；{{some}} / {{any}}

dialog.t: How many people are coming to the party?
About twenty. Do we have enough food?
We have a lot of chips, but there isn't much fruit.
I'll buy some apples and a few bottles of juice.
dialog.tr: 我去买些苹果和几瓶果汁。

dialog.t: Great. How much money do you need?
Just a little. Don't worry!

blocks.p: **能数的和不能数的，用词不一样。** 中文的“多”“少”“一点儿”什么都能说；英语要先看名词能不能数。能数的复数名词（{{apples}}、{{people}}）用 {{many}}、{{a few}}；不可数的（{{money}}、{{time}}、{{water}}）用 {{much}}、{{a little}}。
**{{a lot of}} 最好用。** 肯定句里说“很多”，美国人最常用 {{a lot of}}，可数不可数都行：{{a lot of people}}、{{a lot of time}}。{{much}} 主要用在否定句和问句里：{{I don't have much time.}}（我没多少时间。）

**{{some}} 和 {{any}}。** {{some}}（一些）用在肯定句里：{{I need some eggs.}} {{any}} 用在否定句和问句里：{{Do you have any questions?}}（你们有什么问题吗？）{{I don't have any money.}}（我一点儿钱也没有。）不过请别人吃喝的时候，问句也用 {{some}}：{{Would you like some tea?}}

ex.t: How much time do we have?
There are a lot of cars on the road.
Can I have a little sugar?

blocks.tip: {{a few}} / {{a little}} 是“有一些”（好事），没有 {{a}} 的 {{few}} / {{little}} 是“几乎没有”（不太好）：{{I have a few friends here.}}（我在这儿有几个朋友。）{{I have few friends here.}}（我在这儿几乎没有朋友。）

mistakes.why: {{people}} 是可数的复数，用 {{many}}。

mistakes.right: I have a lot of homework.
mistakes.why: {{homework}} 在英语里不可数，没有复数：{{a lot of homework}}。
否定句里用 {{any}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
“这儿人很多。”
options: {{There are a lot of people here.}}
{{There is a lot of people here.}}
practice.why: {{people}} 是复数：{{there are a lot of}}。

practice.q: 哪一个名词在英语里不可数？
practice.why: {{advice}}（建议）不可数：说 {{some advice}}，不能说 {{an advice}}。

practice.q: 和朋友在超市买东西。选出你的回答。

options: Yes, we only have a few.
Yes, we only have a little.
We don't have much milk. Let's buy some.
We don't have many milk. Let's buy any.

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：说说你的冰箱里有什么：哪些很多，哪些只有一点儿，哪些一点儿也没有。

answers.t: There are a lot of vegetables. There's a little milk. There isn't any meat.
answers.tr: 有很多蔬菜，有一点儿牛奶，一点儿肉也没有。

answers.t: I have a few eggs and a lot of fruit, but I don't have any bread.
answers.tr: 我有几个鸡蛋和很多水果，但是一点儿面包也没有。

lessons.title: 用好 a 和 the
lessons.summary: “我昨晚看了一部电影。那部电影很好看。”：中文没有冠词，所以这一课专门讲 {{a}}、{{the}} 和什么都不用。
lessons.topic: 第一次提到用 {{a}}，再提到用 {{the}}；大家都知道的用 {{the}}；泛指不用冠词（{{I like dogs.}}）；{{go to bed}}、{{go to school}}

goal.t: I saw a movie last night. The movie was great.
goal.tr: 我昨晚看了一部电影。那部电影很好看。

dialog.t: I have a new dog.
Really? What's the dog's name?
dialog.tr: 真的？那只狗叫什么名字？

dialog.t: Max. I take him to the park every morning.
dialog.tr: 麦克斯。我每天早上带它去公园。

dialog.t: I love dogs! I don't have a dog, but I have a cat.
dialog.tr: 我很喜欢狗！我没有狗，但我有一只猫。

dialog.t: Cats are nice too.

blocks.p: **第一次说用 {{a}}，再说用 {{the}}。** 第一次提到一个东西，对方还不知道是哪个，用 {{a}}（某一个）：{{I saw a movie.}}（我看了一部电影。）再提到它，双方都知道是哪个了，用 {{the}}（那个）：{{The movie was great.}}（那部电影很好看。）中文常用“这个”“那个”，或者什么都不加；英语一定要选一个冠词。
**大家都知道是哪个，也用 {{the}}。** 只有一个的：{{the sun}}（太阳）、{{the moon}}（月亮）；在场的人都知道的：{{Close the door, please.}}（请关门。）{{Where's the bathroom?}}（洗手间在哪儿？）{{the}} 就像在说“你知道的那个”。
**泛指：复数或不可数，什么都不加。** 说一类东西或一般的情况，中文说“我喜欢狗”，英语用复数，不加冠词：{{I like dogs.}} 不可数的也一样：{{Coffee is bitter.}}（咖啡是苦的。）如果说 {{I like the dogs.}}，意思就变成了“我喜欢那几只狗”。

table: {{There's a man at the door.}} 门口有个男人。
{{The man wants to see you.}} 那个男人要见你。
{{The sun is hot.}} 太阳很晒。

blocks.p: **几个固定说法不加冠词**：{{go to school}}（上学）、{{go to work}}（上班）、{{go to bed}}（睡觉）、{{at home}}（在家）、{{have breakfast}}（吃早饭）。

ex.t: I saw a movie last night. The movie was great.
ex.tr: 我昨晚看了一部电影。那部电影很好看。

ex.t: There's a cat in the yard.

ex.note: 屋里那扇窗，大家都知道是哪扇

ex.t: My son goes to school at eight.

blocks.tip: 拿不准的时候问问自己：对方知道我说的是哪一个吗？知道，用 {{the}}；不知道，而且只是一个，用 {{a}}；在说一类东西，用复数，什么都不加。

mistakes.why: 泛指一类东西，用复数，不加 {{the}}。{{the cats}} 是“那几只猫”。

mistakes.right: The sun is very hot today.
mistakes.why: 独一无二的东西用 {{the}}：{{the sun}}。

mistakes.wrong: I go to the bed at eleven.
mistakes.right: I go to bed at eleven.
mistakes.why: {{go to bed}} 是固定说法，不加冠词。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: I bought a dress. ___ dress is red.
practice.tr: 我买了一条裙子，是红色的。
practice.why: 第二次提到，已经知道是哪条：{{the}}。

practice.q: “我喜欢咖啡。”
practice.why: 泛指：不可数名词，不加冠词。

practice.q: 你在家，想让家人关灯。你说……
给朋友讲一件事。选出你的话。

options: I found a wallet on the bus.
I found the wallet on a bus.
lines.why: 第一次提到的钱包：{{a wallet}}；{{the bus}} 是你坐的那辆公交车。

options: There was some money in the wallet.
There was some money in a wallet.
lines.why: 已经说过的那个钱包：{{the wallet}}。

options: I gave it to the driver.
lines.why: 那辆车的司机，大家都知道是谁：{{the driver}}。

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：讲一件最近的小事：先用 {{a}} 引出一个人或东西，再用 {{the}} 接着说。

answers.t: I met a woman on the train. The woman was from Spain.
answers.tr: 我在火车上遇到了一位女士。她是西班牙人。

answers.t: I bought a new phone last week. The phone is fast, but the battery is bad.
answers.tr: 我上周买了一部新手机。手机很快，但是电池不好。

lessons.title: 说经历：Have you ever…?
lessons.summary: “你去过美国吗？”“我从来没吃过……”：用现在完成时说这辈子做过、没做过的事，就像中文的“过”。
lessons.topic: 现在完成时：{{have}} / {{has}} + 过去分词；{{ever}}、{{never}}；{{been to}}；和一般过去时的区别

goal.t: Have you ever been to China?

dialog.t: Have you ever tried American barbecue?
No, I've never tried it. Is it good?
dialog.tr: 没有，从来没吃过。好吃吗？

dialog.t: It's amazing. Have you ever been to Texas?
dialog.tr: 超好吃。你去过得克萨斯州吗？

dialog.t: Yes, I've been there once. I went to Houston last year.
dialog.tr: 去过一次。我去年去了休斯敦。

dialog.t: Next time you have to try the barbecue!
dialog.tr: 下次你一定要尝尝那儿的烧烤！

blocks.p: **“过”的英语：现在完成时。** 说一辈子里有没有过某种经历，中文用“过”：“我去过北京”。英语用 {{have}}（他、她、它用 {{has}}）+ 过去分词：{{I have been to Beijing.}}（我去过北京。）口语里缩成 {{I've}}、{{she's}}。

blocks.means: {{have}} / {{has}} + 过去分词，把过去的事和现在连起来，比如说经历：{{I've seen it.}}（我看过。）
动词的另一种形式，用在 {{have}} 后面。规则动词的过去分词和过去式一样（{{worked}}），不规则的要另外记：{{see}} → {{seen}}，{{eat}} → {{eaten}}。

blocks.p: **问“你……过吗？”：{{Have you ever…?}}** {{ever}}（曾经）放在过去分词前面：{{Have you ever seen snow?}}（你见过雪吗？）回答：{{Yes, I have.}} / {{No, I haven't.}} **“从来没有”是 {{never}}**：{{I've never been to Japan.}}（我从来没去过日本。）{{never}} 本身就是否定，不再加 {{not}}。
**一说出具体时间，就用一般过去时。** 现在完成时只说“有过”，不说什么时候；一提到 {{last year}}、{{in 2020}}、{{yesterday}}，就要换回一般过去时：{{I've been to Texas. I went there last year.}}（我去过得州，是去年去的。）

ex.t: Have you ever been to China?
She has visited Paris three times.
Yes, I have. I saw it last week.

blocks.tip: “去过”用 {{been}}：{{I've been to London.}}（我去过伦敦，已经回来了。）{{He's gone to London.}} 是“他去伦敦了”（人还在那儿）。

mistakes.why: {{have}} 后面用过去分词：“去过”是 {{been}}。
有了具体时间（{{yesterday}}），就用一般过去时。
{{never}} 已经是否定，不再加 {{not}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
“我从来没坐过飞机。”
options: {{I haven't never been on a plane.}}

practice.q: “她去年去了日本。”
options: {{She has been to Japan last year.}}

lessons.title: 说做了多久：for 和 since
lessons.summary: “我在这儿住了三年了”“我从二〇二〇年就开始学英语了”：说一件从过去一直持续到现在的事。
lessons.topic: 现在完成时 + {{for}}（多长时间）/ {{since}}（从什么时候起）；{{How long have you…?}}

goal.t: I've lived here for three years.

dialog.t: How long have you lived in this building?
I've lived here for two years. And you?
Since 2015! I love this neighborhood.
dialog.tr: 从二〇一五年开始！我很喜欢这个街区。

dialog.t: Me too. How long have you known Mrs. Lee upstairs?

dialog.t: Oh, for a long time. She's a good friend.

blocks.p: **从过去一直到现在：现在完成时。** 中文说“我在这儿住了三年了”（现在还住着）；英语不能用一般现在时说 {{I live here for three years}}，而要用现在完成时：{{I've lived here for three years.}} 意思是：三年前开始住，到现在还住着。

**{{for}} 说多长时间，{{since}} 说从什么时候起。** {{for}} + 一段时间：{{for two years}}（两年）、{{for a week}}（一个星期）、{{for a long time}}（很久）。{{since}} + 开始的时间点：{{since 2020}}、{{since Monday}}、{{since I was a kid}}（从我小时候起）。

blocks.p: **问多久：{{How long have you…?}}** {{How long have you worked here?}}（你在这儿工作多久了？）{{How long have you known him?}}（你认识他多久了？）

ex.t: I've lived here for three years.
She's worked at the hospital since 2019.
ex.tr: 她从二〇一九年起就在那家医院工作。

ex.t: How long have you studied English?
We've known each other for ten years.

lessons.title: 说刚刚、已经、还没
lessons.summary: “我刚做完”“我已经付过钱了”“你吃饭了吗？——还没”：说刚发生的、已经做了的、还没做的事。
lessons.topic: {{just}}、{{already}}、{{yet}} + 现在完成时；中文的“了”和英语的时态

dialog.t: Have you done your homework yet?
Yes, I've already finished it.
Have you eaten?
No, not yet. I just got home.
OK. Dinner will be ready in five minutes.

blocks.p: **刚刚：{{just}}。** {{just}} 放在 {{have}} 和过去分词中间：{{I've just finished.}}（我刚做完。）{{She's just left.}}（她刚走。）
**已经：{{already}}；还没：{{not… yet}}。** {{already}} 也放在中间：{{I've already eaten.}}（我已经吃过了。）{{yet}} 用在否定句和问句里，放在句末：{{I haven't eaten yet.}}（我还没吃。）{{Have you finished yet?}}（你做完了吗？）简短回答：{{Not yet.}}（还没。）

**中文的“了”，英语不一定用过去时。** “你吃饭了吗？”“我做完了”，说的是现在的结果，英语常用现在完成时：{{Have you eaten?}} {{I've finished.}} 但只要说出过去的时间，就用一般过去时：{{I ate at six.}}（我六点吃的。）另外，美国人说话时也常用一般过去时加 {{just}} / {{already}}：{{I just got home.}}（我刚到家。）{{I already ate.}}（我已经吃了。）两种都对。

blocks.tip: 服务员常问 {{Have you decided yet?}} 或 {{Are you ready to order?}}（可以点菜了吗？）。还没想好，就说 {{Not yet. Can we have a few more minutes?}}（还没有，能再给我们几分钟吗？）

lessons.title: 给建议：should
lessons.summary: “你应该多休息”“你不应该喝那么多咖啡”“我该怎么办？”：用 {{should}} 给建议、问意见。
lessons.topic: {{should}} / {{shouldn't}} + 动词原形；{{I think you should…}}、{{Maybe you should…}}；{{You'd better…}}

dialog.t: I have a terrible headache.
You should take some medicine.
I don't like taking medicine.
Then maybe you should drink some water and rest.
dialog.tr: 那也许你应该喝点儿水，休息一下。

dialog.t: Should I go home early?
Yes, I think you should. You shouldn't work today.
dialog.tr: 对，我觉得应该。你今天不该再工作了。

blocks.p: **{{should}}：应该。** {{should}} 是情态动词，和 {{can}} 一样，后面跟动词原形，对谁都不变：{{You should rest.}}（你应该休息。）{{He should call her.}}（他应该给她打电话。）否定是 {{shouldn't}}：{{You shouldn't eat so late.}}（你不应该吃那么晚。）
**问意见：{{Should I…?}}** {{should}} 自己放到前面：{{Should I buy it?}}（我该买吗？）{{What should I do?}}（我该怎么办？）

**说得更客气一点儿。** 直接说 {{You should…}}，有时听起来有点儿像命令。美国人常在前面加 {{I think}} 或 {{Maybe}}：{{I think you should talk to him.}}（我觉得你应该跟他谈谈。）{{Maybe you should take a break.}}（也许你该歇一会儿。）语气更强、带点儿警告的是 {{You'd better…}}（你最好……）：{{You'd better hurry.}}（你最好快点儿。）

table: 也许你应该问问你的老板。

ex.t: You shouldn't drink so much coffee.
ex.tr: 你不应该喝那么多咖啡。

ex.t: I think you should go to bed early.
ex.tr: 我觉得你应该早点儿睡。

ex.note: 去别人家做客之前常问这一句

blocks.tip: {{You'd better}} = {{you had better}}，后面也是动词原形：{{You'd better go.}}，不说 {{You'd better to go.}}

mistakes.why: {{should}} 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 {{to}}。
{{should}} 不加 {{-s}}。
{{should}} 自己放到前面提问，不用 {{do}}。

lessons.title: 说必须做的事：have to 和 must
lessons.summary: “我得上班”“你不用来”“这里不许停车”：说必须做的、不用做的和不许做的事。
lessons.topic: {{have to}} / {{has to}}；{{don't have to}}（不用）；{{must}} / {{mustn't}}（不许）；过去的 {{had to}}

dialog.t: Do you want to go to the beach on Saturday?
I'd love to, but I have to work.
Oh no. Do you have to work on Sunday too?
dialog.tr: 哎呀。星期天也要上班吗？

dialog.t: No, I don't have to. Let's go on Sunday!
Great. But we have to leave early. Parking is hard there.
dialog.tr: 好。不过我们得早点儿出发，那儿很难停车。

blocks.p: **必须、得：{{have to}}。** 中文说“我得……”“我要……”；英语最常用 {{have to}} + 动词原形，他、她、它用 {{has to}}：{{I have to go.}}（我得走了。）{{She has to work late.}}（她得加班。）提问和否定用 {{do}}：{{Do you have to…?}}
**不用：{{don't have to}}；不许：{{mustn't}}。** 这两个中国学生最容易混。{{don't have to}} 是“不用、不必”（做也行，不做也行）：{{You don't have to come.}}（你不用来。）{{mustn't}} 是“不许、绝对不能”：{{You mustn't smoke here.}}（这里不许抽烟。）

table: {{I have to finish this today.}} 我今天得做完。
{{You must wear a seatbelt.}} 必须系安全带。
{{You don't have to pay.}} 你不用付钱。
{{You mustn't tell anyone.}} 你绝对不能告诉任何人。

blocks.p: **过去：{{had to}}。** {{must}} 没有过去式，说“当时不得不”用 {{had to}}：{{I had to wait an hour.}}（我当时不得不等了一个小时。）美国人日常说话时，{{have to}} 比 {{must}} 常用得多；{{must}} 多见于规定和标志。

ex.t: She has to take the bus to work.
You don't have to bring anything.
Do I have to pay now?
We had to wait for two hours.
ex.tr: 我们不得不等了两个小时。

blocks.tip: {{have to}} 读作 /ˈhæftə/，{{has to}} 读作 /ˈhæstə/：这里的 v 读得像 f。

mistakes.why: “不用”是 {{don't have to}}；{{mustn't}} 是“不许”，意思完全不同！
{{she}} 用 {{has to}}。
{{must}} 是情态动词，后面直接跟原形，不加 {{to}}。

lessons.title: 说原因和转折：because、so、although、but
lessons.summary: “因为下雨，所以我们没去”：中文喜欢成对用连词，英语只用一个！
lessons.topic: {{because}} 或 {{so}}（不能一起用）；{{although}} 或 {{but}}（不能一起用）；{{because of}} + 名词

goal.t: I didn't go because it was raining.

dialog.t: Why didn't you come to the party?
Because I had to work late. Sorry!
That's OK. It was a little boring, so we left early.
dialog.tr: 没关系。有点儿无聊，所以我们早早就走了。

dialog.t: But I saw your photos. It looked fun!
dialog.tr: 可是我看了你们的照片，看起来挺好玩的！

dialog.t: Although the food was good, the music was terrible!
dialog.tr: 虽然吃的不错，但音乐太难听了！

blocks.p: **中文成对，英语单个。** 中文说“因为……所以……”“虽然……但是……”，前后两个词一起用。英语只用其中一个：{{Because it rained, we stayed home.}} 或者 {{It rained, so we stayed home.}}，绝不能说 {{Because it rained, so we stayed home.}}

table: 因为下雨，所以我们没去。
{{We didn't go because it rained.}} / {{It rained, so we didn't go.}}
{{Although it's expensive, it's good.}} / {{It's expensive, but it's good.}}

blocks.p: **{{because}} 说原因**，可以放在后半句，也可以放在开头（放开头时，两个半句之间加逗号）：{{I'm tired because I worked late.}} **{{so}} 说结果**，放在后半句：{{I worked late, so I'm tired.}} 回答 {{Why?}} 的时候，可以只说 {{Because…}}
**{{although}}、{{but}} 说转折。** {{although}}（虽然）放在前半句的开头，{{but}}（但是）放在后半句的开头，两个只能选一个。口语里 {{but}} 最常用，{{although}} 正式一点儿；还有 {{though}}，放在句末表示“不过”：{{It's expensive. It's good, though.}}
**{{because of}} + 名词**：{{We stayed home because of the rain.}}（因为下雨，我们待在家里。）{{because}} 后面是一个句子，{{because of}} 后面是名词。

ex.t: I didn't go because it was raining.
It was late, so I took a taxi.
Although he's young, he's very smart.
The hotel was small but clean.
The flight was late because of the snow.
I like my job. It's hard, though.
ex.tr: 我喜欢我的工作，不过挺累的。

blocks.tip: 写作时，{{because}} 放在句首，就要把两个半句都写完整：{{Because I was sick, I stayed home.}} 单独一句 {{Because I was sick.}} 只能用来回答问题。

mistakes.right: We stayed home because of the rain.

mistakes.why: 后面是名词，要用 {{because of}}。

lessons.title: 说“如果……就……”：if + 现在时，will
lessons.summary: “如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里”：说有可能发生的事和它的结果。注意：{{if}} 后面不用 {{will}}！
lessons.topic: 第一条件句：{{If}} + 一般现在时，{{will}} + 动词原形；{{when}}、{{as soon as}} + 现在时

goal.t: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home.
goal.tr: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

dialog.t: Are we still going hiking on Saturday?
dialog.tr: 我们星期六还去徒步吗？

dialog.t: If the weather is good, we'll go.
And if it rains?
If it rains, we'll go to a museum.

dialog.t: OK. I'll call you when I wake up.

blocks.p: **如果……就……：{{if}} + 现在时，{{will}} + 动词。** 说将来可能发生的事，{{if}} 那半句用一般现在时，结果那半句用 {{will}}：{{If it rains, we'll stay home.}}（如果下雨，我们就待在家里。）中文的“就”，英语不用翻译出来。

blocks.means: 带 {{if}}（如果）的句子：一半说条件，一半说结果。

blocks.p: **{{if}} 后面不用 {{will}}。** 虽然说的是将来，{{if}} 后面也用现在时：{{If I see him, I'll tell him.}}（如果我见到他，我就告诉他。）不能说 {{If I will see him}}。{{when}}（等……的时候）、{{as soon as}}（一……就……）也一样：{{I'll call you when I get home.}}（我到家就给你打电话。）

table: 如果你饿了，我就煮点儿面。
如果她不来，我们就先开始。

blocks.p: **两个半句的顺序可以换。** {{if}} 在前，中间加逗号：{{If it rains, we'll stay home.}} {{if}} 在后，不加逗号：{{We'll stay home if it rains.}}

ex.t: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home.

ex.t: If you need help, I'll be here.

If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.

ex.t: What will you do if you lose your job?

blocks.tip: {{unless}} = {{if… not}}（除非）：{{I won't go unless you come.}}（除非你去，否则我不去。）

lessons.title: 想象：If I had…, I would…
lessons.summary: “如果我有一百万，我就……”“如果我是你，我就……”：想象不真实的情况，给别人出主意，或者说你希望怎样。
lessons.topic: 第二条件句：{{If}} + 过去式，{{would}} + 动词原形；{{If I were you…}}；{{I wish…}}

goal.t: If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
goal.tr: 如果我有一百万美元，我就去环游世界。

dialog.t: What would you do if you won the lottery?
dialog.tr: 如果你中了彩票，你会做什么？

dialog.t: I'd buy a house for my parents. And you?
dialog.tr: 我会给我爸妈买套房子。你呢？

dialog.t: I'd quit my job and travel!
Really? If I were you, I'd keep my job. You love it!
dialog.tr: 真的？如果我是你，我会留着这份工作。你那么喜欢它！

dialog.t: True. I wish I had more vacation days, though.
dialog.tr: 也对。不过我真希望假期能多几天。

blocks.p: **想象不真实的事：{{if}} + 过去式，{{would}} + 动词。** 中文说“如果我有钱，我就……”，可能是真的，也可能只是想象；英语分得很清楚。现在不是这样、只是想象的时候，{{if}} 后面用过去式，结果用 {{would}}（口语 {{'d}}）：{{If I had more time, I would learn the piano.}}（要是我有更多时间，我就学钢琴。）其实我现在没时间。
**这里的过去式不是“过去”。** {{If I had…}} 说的是现在，过去式只是表示“这不是真的”。比较一下：{{If I have time, I'll come.}}（我如果有空就来，有可能。）{{If I had time, I'd come.}}（我要是有空就来了，可惜没空。）
**{{If I were you}}：给建议。** 这种句子里，{{I}}、{{he}}、{{she}} 后面也常用 {{were}}：{{If I were you, I'd take the job.}}（如果我是你，我就接受这份工作。）口语里也常听到 {{If I was you}}。
**{{I wish}}：希望现在不一样。** {{I wish}} + 过去式，表示对现在的遗憾：{{I wish I had a car.}}（真希望我有辆车。可惜没有。）{{I wish I could speak English well.}}（真希望我英语说得好。）

ex.t: If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
ex.tr: 如果我有一百万美元，我就去环游世界。

ex.t: What would you do if you were me?
ex.tr: 如果你是我，你会怎么做？

ex.t: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
ex.tr: 如果我是你，我会去看医生。

ex.t: If I lived near the beach, I'd swim every day.
ex.tr: 如果我住在海边，我就每天游泳。

ex.t: I wish I had more time.
I wish I could cook like my mom.
ex.tr: 真希望我能像我妈妈那样会做饭。

blocks.tip: {{would}} 后面也用动词原形，对谁都不变。{{I'd}} 可能是 {{I would}}，也可能是 {{I had}}，看后面的词就知道了。

mistakes.wrong: If I have a million dollars, I would buy a house.
mistakes.right: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a house.
mistakes.tr: 如果我有一百万美元，我就买套房子。
mistakes.why: 想象的事，{{if}} 后面用过去式：{{had}}。

mistakes.wrong: If I would be you, I would go.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would go.
mistakes.why: {{if}} 后面不用 {{would}}：{{If I were you}}。

mistakes.wrong: I wish I have a car.
mistakes.right: I wish I had a car.
mistakes.why: {{I wish}} 后面用过去式。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: If I ___ more money, I'd buy a new car.

我以前有时间的时候常来。
practice.why: 过去式表示“不是真的”：其实没有时间。

lines.tr: 如果你不用工作，你会做什么？

I go to Italy. I wish I can speak Italian!

轮到你了：如果你中了一大笔钱，你会做什么？再说一件你希望现在不一样的事（{{I wish…}}）。

answers.t: I'd help my family and travel to Africa. I wish I lived closer to my parents.

lessons.title: 说清楚是哪一个：who、which、that
lessons.summary: “住在隔壁的那个人”“我昨天买的那本书”：中文把描述放在名词前面，英语放在后面！
lessons.topic: 定语从句：名词 + {{who}}（人）/ {{which}}（东西）/ {{that}}（都行）+ 句子；{{that}} 有时可以省；{{where}}

goal.t: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
goal.tr: 住在隔壁的那个男的是医生。

dialog.t: Who's that woman over there?
Which one?
The woman who's wearing the red dress.
Oh, that's Jenny. She's the friend I told you about.
dialog.tr: 哦，那是珍妮，就是我跟你说过的那个朋友。

dialog.t: The one who works at the hospital?
Yes! Let's go say hi.

blocks.p: **描述放在名词后面。** 中文的描述放在名词前面，用“的”连起来：“我昨天买的书”“住在隔壁的人”。英语正好相反：先说名词，再用 {{who}}、{{which}} 或 {{that}} 接上描述：{{the book that I bought yesterday}}、{{the man who lives next door}}。

blocks.means: 放在名词后面、说明是哪个人或哪个东西的一小句话，用 {{who}}、{{which}}、{{that}} 开头。它就像中文的“……的”，只是位置在后面。

blocks.p: **{{who}}、{{which}}、{{that}} 怎么选？** 说人用 {{who}}，说东西用 {{which}}；{{that}} 人和东西都能用，口语里最常用。说地点用 {{where}}：{{the city where I was born}}（我出生的城市）。
**{{that}} 有时可以省略。** 后面的描述里已经有自己的主语（{{I}}、{{she}}……）的时候，{{that}} 可以不说：{{the book (that) I bought}}、{{the friend (that) I told you about}}。这样就和中文很像了：“我买的书”。

ex.t: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
ex.tr: 住在隔壁的那个男的是医生。

ex.t: This is the book I bought yesterday.
I have a friend who speaks five languages.
ex.tr: 我有个朋友会说五种语言。

ex.t: The movie that we saw was really scary.
ex.tr: 我们看的那部电影特别吓人。

ex.t: That's the restaurant where we met.
ex.tr: 那就是我们认识的那家餐厅。

ex.t: Do you know anyone who can fix my computer?
ex.tr: 你认识会修电脑的人吗？

blocks.tip: 长句子不要怕，先抓住名词：{{The woman (who's wearing the red dress) is Jenny.}} 去掉括号里的部分，句子就是 {{The woman is Jenny.}}

mistakes.wrong: I bought yesterday book is good.
mistakes.right: The book I bought yesterday is good.
mistakes.why: 英语的描述放在名词后面：{{the book I bought yesterday}}。

mistakes.wrong: The man which lives next door is nice.
mistakes.right: The man who lives next door is nice.
mistakes.tr: 住在隔壁的男人人很好。
mistakes.why: 说人用 {{who}}（或 {{that}}），不用 {{which}}。

mistakes.wrong: This is the book that I bought it.
mistakes.right: This is the book that I bought.
mistakes.why: {{that}} 已经代替了那本书，后面不再加 {{it}}。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: I have a friend ___ lives in Seattle.
practice.tr: 我有个朋友住在西雅图。

practice.q: “这是我昨天买的手机。”
options: {{This is the phone I bought yesterday.}}
{{This is I bought yesterday the phone.}}
{{This is the phone I bought it yesterday.}}
practice.why: 名词在前，描述在后，不要多余的 {{it}}。

practice.q: “那就是我出生的城市。”
options: {{That's the city where I was born.}}
{{That's the city who I was born.}}
{{That's where I was born the city.}}

practice.q: 在聚会上找人。选出你的回答。

options: The man who works with my sister.
The man which works with my sister.
He's the one who's wearing glasses.
lines.why: 描述放在名词后面：{{the one who's wearing glasses}}。

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
practice.tr: 我们看的那部电影特别吓人。

practice.q: 轮到你了：介绍一个对你很重要的人或地方，用 {{who}}、{{that}} 或 {{where}} 说清楚。

answers.t: My aunt is a woman who always helps people. She lives in the town where I grew up.
answers.tr: 我姑姑是个总是帮助别人的人。她住在我长大的那个小镇。

answers.t: The best gift I ever got is a watch that my grandpa gave me.
answers.tr: 我收到过的最好的礼物，是我爷爷给我的一块手表。

lessons.title: 讲故事：was doing / when
lessons.summary: “我正走在回家的路上，突然下起了雨”：用过去进行时描述背景，用一般过去时讲突然发生的事。
lessons.topic: 过去进行时 {{was}} / {{were}} + {{-ing}}；{{when}}、{{while}}；{{first}}、{{then}}、{{after that}}、{{finally}}

goal.t: I was walking home when it started to rain.
goal.tr: 我正走着回家，突然下起了雨。

dialog.t: You won't believe what happened yesterday.
dialog.tr: 你肯定猜不到我昨天遇到了什么事。

dialog.t: What happened?
I was waiting for the bus when a man ran up to me.
dialog.tr: 我正在等公交车，一个男的朝我跑过来。

dialog.t: Whoa. What did he want?
He was holding my wallet! I dropped it while I was getting off the train.
dialog.tr: 他手里拿着我的钱包！原来我下火车的时候把它弄掉了。

dialog.t: That's so nice! You were lucky.

blocks.p: **故事的背景：过去进行时。** 讲故事时，先描述当时正在发生的事，用 {{was}} / {{were}} + {{-ing}}：{{I was walking home.}}（我当时正走着回家。）{{The sun was shining.}}（那时阳光灿烂。）就像中文的“当时正在……”。
**突然发生的事：一般过去时。** 在这个背景里突然插进来的事，用一般过去时，常用 {{when}} 连接：{{I was walking home when it started to rain.}}（我正走着回家，突然下起了雨。）{{while}}（在……的时候）后面常接进行时：{{While I was cooking, the phone rang.}}（我做饭的时候，电话响了。）

table: 突然发生的事（一般过去时）

blocks.p: **把故事串起来。** 讲先后顺序：{{first}}（首先）、{{then}}（然后）、{{after that}}（在那之后）、{{finally}}（最后）。中文的“了”在英语里都要变成过去式：{{First we went to the beach. Then we had lunch. Finally we went home.}}

ex.t: I was walking home when it started to rain.
ex.tr: 我正走着回家，突然下起了雨。

ex.t: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
ex.tr: 我做饭的时候，电话响了。

ex.t: What were you doing at eight last night?
We were watching TV when the lights went out.
ex.tr: 我们正在看电视，突然停电了。

ex.t: First we checked in. Then we went to the beach.
ex.tr: 我们先办了入住，然后去了海边。

ex.t: Finally, we got home at midnight.

blocks.tip: 听别人讲故事时，可以这样回应：{{Really?}}（真的？）{{What happened next?}}（后来呢？）{{Oh no!}}（哎呀！）{{You're kidding!}}（开玩笑吧！）

mistakes.wrong: I was walk home when it started to rain.
mistakes.right: I was walking home when it started to rain.
mistakes.tr: 我正走着回家，突然下起了雨。
mistakes.why: 过去进行时：{{was}} + {{-ing}}。

mistakes.wrong: While I cooked, the phone was ringing.
mistakes.right: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
mistakes.tr: 我做饭的时候，电话响了。
mistakes.why: 背景用进行时（{{was cooking}}），突然发生的事用一般过去时（{{rang}}）。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: We were having dinner when the doorbell ___.
practice.tr: 我们正吃着晚饭，门铃响了。
practice.why: 突然发生的事：一般过去时 {{rang}}。

practice.q: “昨晚十点你在干什么？”
options: {{What were you doing at ten last night?}}
{{What did you doing at ten last night?}}
{{What you were doing at ten last night?}}
practice.why: 问当时正在做什么：{{What were you doing…?}}

practice.q: 哪一句的顺序词用对了？
options: {{First we bought tickets. Then we went inside.}}
{{Finally we bought tickets. First we went inside.}}

practice.q: 朋友让你讲讲机场的事。选出你的话。

lines.t: So what happened at the airport?

options: I was waiting in line when I saw my old teacher.
I waited in line when I was seeing my old teacher.
lines.why: 背景：{{was waiting}}；突然发生的事：{{saw}}。

lines.t: No way! What did you do?

options: I said hello, and then we had coffee together.
I was saying hello, and then we were having coffee together.
lines.why: 一件接一件发生的事，用一般过去时。

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
practice.tr: 我做饭的时候，电话响了。

practice.q: 轮到你了：讲一个小故事：当时你正在做什么，突然发生了什么，后来怎么样了。

answers.t: I was shopping last week when I met an old friend. We went to a café and talked for two hours.
answers.tr: 上周我正在逛街，碰到了一个老朋友。我们去了咖啡店，聊了两个小时。

answers.t: I was sleeping when my phone rang at three in the morning. It was my brother. He was in Australia and he forgot the time difference!
answers.tr: 凌晨三点我正睡着，电话响了。是我哥哥，他在澳大利亚，忘了时差！

lessons.title: 转述别人的话
lessons.summary: “她说她会晚点儿到”“他问我是不是学生”：把别人的话告诉第三个人。英语转述时，时态常常往后退一步。
lessons.topic: {{He said (that)…}}、{{She told me (that)…}}；{{said}} 和 {{told}}；时态后退（{{is}} → {{was}}，{{will}} → {{would}}）；{{He asked if…}}

dialog.t: Did Lisa call?
Yes. She said she would be late.
dialog.tr: 打了，她说她会晚点儿到。

dialog.t: Did she say why?
She told me her car wasn't working.
Oh no. Did she ask about the meeting?
dialog.tr: 哎呀。她问会议的事了吗？

dialog.t: Yes, she asked if we could wait for her.
dialog.tr: 问了，她问我们能不能等等她。

blocks.p: **转述：{{said}} 和 {{told}}。** {{say}} 后面直接跟说的内容：{{He said (that) he was busy.}}（他说他很忙。）{{tell}} 后面要先说告诉谁：{{He told me (that) he was busy.}}（他告诉我他很忙。）不能说 {{He said me…}}。{{that}} 可以省略。

**时态往后退一步。** 中文转述时动词不变；英语用 {{said}} 转述时，原话的时态常常往过去退一步：{{“I'm tired.”}} → {{She said she was tired.}} {{“I will call you.”}} → {{He said he would call me.}} {{“I can come.”}} → {{She said she could come.}} 人称也要换成转述人的角度（{{I}} → {{she}}）。

**转述问题：{{asked}} + {{if}} 或疑问词，用陈述句的语序。** {{“Are you a student?”}} → {{She asked if I was a student.}}（她问我是不是学生。）{{“Where do you live?”}} → {{He asked where I lived.}}（他问我住在哪儿。）注意：转述的问题不再倒装，也不用 {{do}}。

ex.t: He told me he would call later.
ex.tr: 他告诉我他晚点儿会打电话。

ex.t: My boss said I could leave early.
ex.tr: 老板说我可以早点儿走。

ex.t: She asked if I was a student.
He asked me where I lived.

ex.note: 用 {{says}}（现在时）转述，时态不用变

blocks.tip: 转述刚说过、现在还成立的话，时态也可以不变：{{She said she's coming.}}（她说她要来。）口语里两种说法都常听到。

mistakes.wrong: He said me he was busy.
mistakes.right: He told me he was busy.
mistakes.why: 后面有“告诉谁”，用 {{told}}；{{said}} 后面不直接跟人。

mistakes.wrong: She asked me where do I live.
mistakes.right: She asked me where I lived.
mistakes.why: 转述的问题用陈述句语序，不用 {{do}}。

mistakes.wrong: He asked me am I tired.
mistakes.right: He asked me if I was tired.
mistakes.why: 转述是非问题用 {{if}}，语序用陈述句。

practice.q: 选出正确的词。
practice.t: She ___ me she was moving to Boston.
practice.tr: 她告诉我她要搬到波士顿。

practice.q: 朋友说 {{“I'll be there at seven.”}} 你转述给别人：
options: {{He said he would be there at seven.}}
{{He told he would be there at seven.}}
{{He said me he would be there at seven.}}
practice.why: {{said}} 后面不直接跟人，{{told}} 后面一定要有人；{{will}} 往后退一步变成 {{would}}。

practice.q: 医生问你 {{“Do you smoke?”}} 你告诉家人：
options: {{The doctor asked if did I smoke.}}
practice.why: 是非问题：{{asked if}} + 陈述句语序，时态往后退。

practice.q: 同事打来电话，你转告老板。选出你的话。

options: It was Mark. He said he was sick today.
It was Mark. He said me he was sick today.
He asked if he could work from home tomorrow.
He asked can he work from home tomorrow.
lines.why: 转述问题：{{asked if}} + 陈述句语序。

practice.q: 把单词排成正确的顺序。
轮到你了：转述一件最近有人告诉你的事，和一个有人问你的问题。

answers.t: My friend told me she was getting married. She asked if I could come to the wedding.
answers.tr: 我朋友告诉我她要结婚了。她问我能不能去参加婚礼。

answers.t: My mom said she was proud of me. She asked when I would visit.
answers.tr: 我妈妈说她为我骄傲。她问我什么时候回去看她。

lessons.title: 常用短语动词
lessons.summary: “起床”“开灯”“找钥匙”“别放弃”：美国人每天都在用的“动词 + 小词”，意思常常猜不出来。
lessons.topic: 短语动词：{{get up}}、{{turn on}} / {{off}}、{{put on}} / {{take off}}、{{look for}}、{{find out}}、{{pick up}}、{{give up}}；{{turn it on}}（代词放中间）

goal.t: Can you turn on the light?

dialog.t: Wake up! It's seven o'clock.
OK, I'm getting up.
Put on your coat. It's cold outside.
Where is it? I'm looking for it.
It's on the chair. And turn off the TV, please.
dialog.tr: 在椅子上。还有，请把电视关了。

dialog.t: OK, I'll turn it off.

blocks.p: **动词 + 小词 = 新意思。** 英语里很多常用的说法，是一个动词加一个小词（{{up}}、{{on}}、{{off}}、{{out}}……），合起来的意思常常和原来的动词不太一样：{{get up}}（起床）、{{give up}}（放弃）、{{find out}}（查明、发现）。最好的办法是把它们当成一个整体来记。

blocks.means: 动词加上 {{up}}、{{on}}、{{off}} 等小词组成的说法，意思常常是一个整体，比如 {{turn on}}（打开）。

table: {{Can you pick me up at six?}}

blocks.p: **“开灯”不是 {{open the light}}。** 中文说“开灯”“关电视”；英语的 {{open}} / {{close}} 只用于门、窗、盒子这些能打开的东西，电器要用 {{turn on}} / {{turn off}}：{{Turn on the light.}}（开灯。）{{Turn off the air conditioner.}}（关空调。）
**代词放在中间。** 宾语是名词时，放中间或后面都行：{{Turn off the TV.}} = {{Turn the TV off.}} 但宾语是 {{it}}、{{them}} 这类代词时，一定要放在中间：{{Turn it off.}}，不能说 {{Turn off it.}}（{{look for}} 这样的例外：{{I'm looking for it.}}）

ex.t: Can you turn on the light?
I usually get up at six thirty.
Put on your jacket. It's cold.
Can you pick me up at the airport?
Learning English is hard, but don't give up!
ex.tr: 学英语不容易，但别放弃！

blocks.tip: 在家里边做边说：{{wake up}}（醒来）、{{get up}}（起床）、{{put on}}（穿上）、{{turn on}}（打开）、{{take off}}（脱下）、{{turn off}}（关掉）。每天说一遍，很快就记住了。

mistakes.why: 电器用 {{turn on}}，不用 {{open}}。
代词 {{it}} 要放在中间：{{turn it off}}。

lessons.title: 看懂被动句
lessons.summary: “这是中国制造的”“我的自行车被偷了”“这里说英语”：英语的被动句比中文的“被”用得多得多。
lessons.topic: 被动语态：{{be}} + 过去分词（{{It was made in China.}}）；{{by}} + 做的人；不只用于坏事

goal.t: This phone was made in China.
goal.tr: 这部手机是中国制造的。

dialog.t: This building was built in 1890.
Wow! Who designed it?
It was designed by a famous architect. And these paintings were made by local artists.
dialog.tr: 是一位著名建筑师设计的。这些画是本地画家画的。

dialog.t: Can we take photos?
Sorry, photos aren't allowed inside.

blocks.p: **被动句：{{be}} + 过去分词。** 不说谁做的，只说东西怎么样了，就用被动句：{{The house was built in 1990.}}（这房子是一九九〇年建的。）{{English is spoken here.}}（这里说英语。）{{be}} 要跟着时态变：{{is made}}（现在）、{{was made}}（过去）、{{will be made}}（将来）。

blocks.means: 让“被做的东西”当主语的句子：{{be}} + 过去分词，比如 {{It was made in China.}}（它是在中国制造的。）

blocks.p: **英语的被动比中文的“被”常用得多。** 中文的“被”多用于不好的事：“我的钱包被偷了”。英语的被动句什么事都能说，新闻、说明书、标志里到处都是：{{Breakfast is served at seven.}}（早餐七点供应。）{{The store is closed on Sundays.}}（商店周日不营业。）这些句子中文往往不用“被”。

table: 这些手机是中国制造的。

blocks.p: **想说是谁做的，用 {{by}}**：{{The book was written by a young doctor.}}（这本书是一位年轻医生写的。）不过大多数被动句都不说 {{by}}：谁做的不重要，或者不知道。

ex.t: This phone was made in China.
ex.tr: 这部手机是中国制造的。

ex.t: My bike was stolen last night.
ex.tr: 我的自行车昨晚被偷了。

ex.t: The store is closed on Sundays.
Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
The song was written by my favorite singer.
ex.tr: 这首歌是我最喜欢的歌手写的。

blocks.tip: 你不一定要经常自己说被动句，但要能一眼看懂：看到 {{be}} + 过去分词，就想到“东西被怎么样了”。标志、通知、说明书上特别多。

mistakes.right: This phone was made in China.
mistakes.tr: 这部手机是中国制造的。
mistakes.why: 被动句一定要有 {{be}}：{{was made}}。
{{be}} 后面用过去分词：{{steal}} → {{stolen}}。

lessons.title: 回答否定问句
lessons.summary: “你不喜欢吗？——对，我不喜欢。”：中文和英语回答否定问句的方式正好相反，很容易说错。
lessons.topic: {{Don't you…?}}、{{Aren't you…?}}；英语按事实回答：{{Yes, I do.}} / {{No, I don't.}}；附加问句 {{…, isn't it?}}、{{…, right?}}

goal.t: Don't you like coffee? — No, I don't.
goal.tr: 你不喜欢咖啡吗？——对，我不喜欢。

dialog.t: Aren't you hungry?
No, I'm not. I had a big lunch.
Don't you want any cake?
dialog.tr: 你一点儿蛋糕都不想吃吗？

dialog.t: Yes, I do! I always want cake.
dialog.tr: 想吃！蛋糕我随时都想吃。

dialog.t: Ha! It's delicious, isn't it?
Yes, it is.

blocks.p: **中文按对方的话回答，英语按事实回答。** 中文里，别人问“你不喜欢吗？”，你不喜欢，就说“对，我不喜欢”，是在同意对方的说法。英语不看问题怎么问，只看事实：不喜欢，就说 {{No}}；喜欢，就说 {{Yes}}。{{Yes}} 后面一定是肯定，{{No}} 后面一定是否定。
**最保险的办法：别只说 {{yes}} 或 {{no}}。** 后面加上完整的简短回答，甚至再加一句，对方就不会误会：{{No, I don't like it.}} {{Yes, I am tired.}}
**附加问句：“……，是吧？”** 想让对方确认，就在句子后面加一个小问句：肯定句后面用否定，否定句后面用肯定：{{It's cold, isn't it?}}（挺冷的，是吧？）{{You don't eat meat, do you?}}（你不吃肉，对吧？）口语里简单地加一个 {{right?}} 也行：{{You're from Beijing, right?}}

ex.t: Aren't you cold? — No, I'm fine.
ex.tr: 你不冷吗？——不冷，我挺好的。

ex.t: Didn't you see the email? — Yes, I did.
ex.tr: 你没看到那封邮件吗？——看到了。

ex.t: Isn't she coming? — No, she's sick.
It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
You don't eat meat, do you?

blocks.tip: 别人用否定问句问你，常常说明他们有点儿惊讶：{{Don't you know him?}} 的意思是“你居然不认识他？”

mistakes.wrong: — Aren't you hungry? — Yes, I'm not hungry.
mistakes.right: — Aren't you hungry? — No, I'm not hungry.
mistakes.why: 英语按事实回答：不饿，就用 {{No}}。{{Yes}} 后面不能跟否定。
肯定句后面加否定的附加问句：{{isn't it?}}

lessons.title: 让对话继续下去
lessons.summary: “我也是！”“我也不！”“你呢？”“后来呢？”：用简短的回应和追问，让聊天自然地进行下去。
lessons.topic: {{So do I}} / {{Me too}}；{{Neither do I}} / {{Me neither}}；{{What about you?}}；追问 {{How was it?}}、{{What happened next?}}

goal.t: I love traveling. — So do I!

dialog.t: I'm from Seattle. I love the rain!
dialog.tr: 我是西雅图人，我喜欢下雨！

dialog.t: Really? I don't like rain at all.
dialog.tr: 真的？我一点儿也不喜欢下雨。

dialog.t: Ha, a lot of people don't. What about you? Where are you from?
dialog.tr: 哈，很多人都不喜欢。你呢？你是哪里人？

dialog.t: I'm from Kunming. It's sunny almost every day.
dialog.tr: 我是昆明人，那儿几乎每天都是晴天。

dialog.t: That sounds nice! I've never been to China.
dialog.tr: 听起来真不错！我从来没去过中国。

dialog.t: Neither has my wife! She's American too.
dialog.tr: 我太太也没去过！她也是美国人。

dialog.t: No way! How did you two meet?
dialog.tr: 不会吧！你们俩是怎么认识的？

blocks.p: **“我也是”：{{Me too.}} / {{So do I.}}** 同意别人的肯定句，口语里最简单的是 {{Me too!}}。稍微正式一点儿，用 {{So}} + 助动词 + {{I}}，助动词要和对方的句子对上：{{I love pizza. — So do I.}}（{{do}}）{{I'm tired. — So am I.}}（{{am}}）{{I went there. — So did I.}}（{{did}}）

**“我也不”：{{Me neither.}} / {{Neither do I.}}** 同意别人的否定句，不能说 {{Me too}}，要说 {{Me neither}}，或者 {{Neither}} + 助动词 + {{I}}：{{I don't eat meat. — Neither do I.}}（我也不吃肉。）{{I can't swim. — Neither can I.}}（我也不会游泳。）
**把话题接下去。** 美国人聊天时，很喜欢把问题还给对方，或者追问细节：{{What about you?}}（你呢？）{{How was it?}}（怎么样？）{{What happened next?}}（后来呢？）{{How did you…?}}（你是怎么……的？）只回答“是”或“不是”，对话很快就停了；多问一句，对方会觉得你感兴趣。

ex.t: I'm really tired today. — So am I.
I don't like horror movies. — Me neither.
ex.tr: 我不喜欢恐怖片。——我也不喜欢。

ex.t: I can't speak Spanish. — Neither can I.
ex.tr: 我不会说西班牙语。——我也不会。

ex.t: I went to Hawaii last year. — Really? How was it?
ex.tr: 我去年去了夏威夷。——真的？怎么样？

ex.t: I'm a nurse. What about you?

blocks.tip: 聊天时的小回应很重要：{{Really?}}（真的？）{{That's great!}}（太好了！）{{Oh no!}}（哎呀！）{{I see.}}（我明白了。）{{No way!}}（不会吧！）边听边说，对方会讲得更起劲。

mistakes.wrong: — I don't like coffee. — Me too.
mistakes.right: — I don't like coffee. — Me neither.
mistakes.why: 同意否定句，用 {{Me neither}}，不用 {{Me too}}。
对方用的是 {{am}}，回答也要用 {{am}}：{{So am I.}}
